Klimaschutz beginnt im Regenwald. Die Regenwälder in West- und Zentralafrika gelten als Lungen der Welt. Nach Schätzungen von WWF werden bis 2030 rund 30 % davon verschwunden sein. In 50 Jahren werden voraussichtlich nur noch kleine tropische Waldflächen übrig bleiben. Diese Zahlen sind angesichts des steigenden Bewusstseins über die Bedeutung des Klimaschutzes für den Erhalt des Planeten dramatisch.

pr.t: Juwel der Elefantenküste: Afrikas Wunderland Isimangaliso
pr.d: 3280 Quadratkilometer am Meer mit Elefanten, Nashörnern, Büffeln, Löwen und Leoparden: Der südafrikanische Nationalpark heißt Isimangaliso, in der Sprache der Zulus schlicht Wunder. Der Küstenstreifen wurde 1999 zum ersten UNESCO-Weltnaturerbe Südafrikas erklärt. Isimangaliso bietet mit seinen ausgedehnten Feuchtgebieten, Sumpflandschaften, Savannen und Küstenwäldern eine unvergleichliche Biodiversität mit entsprechender Artenvielfalt.

pr.t: Die Magie des Leoparden - Ökotourismus in Südafrikas Wildreservaten
pr.d: Afrikanische Tierparks locken jährlich hunderttausende Besucher aus aller Welt nach Südafrika. Der Wildlife-Tourismus nimmt rapide zu und sorgt damit für das Entstehen von Boomtowns wie Nelspruit und Hoedspruit rund um den Krüger-Nationalpark. Heute leben hunderttausende Menschen zumindest indirekt von der Anziehungskraft des Safari-Abenteuers. Es wird gezeigt, wie die Verbindung von Luxustourismus, Umwelt- und Wildtierschutz zu sozialer Gerechtigkeit führen kann.

pr.t: Himba, Buschmänner und Löwen - Wildnis- und Kulturmarketing in Namibia
pr.d: Ein Reisebus nähert sich dem San-Dorf Grashoek in Namibia. Ein Schild begrüßt die Besucher im Bushman Living Museum. Noch im Bus beginnen die Insassen zu fotografieren. Eine typische Szene - und doch hat sie wenig gemeinsam mit üblichen Szenarien im Kultur-Tourismus. Keine anstürmenden Kinderscharen, keine laufenden Frauen, die aufgeregt Handwerkskunst anbieten und auch keine jungen Männer, die gegen Entgelt ihre Dienste anbieten.

Phinda ist eine der Juwelen privater Wildreservate in Südafrika und damit ein Hotspot für Safari-Touristen. Wer Geparde sehen will, hat dort die besten Chancen, doch seine eigentliche Aufgabe ist die Fürsorge für das Land und dessen Bevölkerung.

Afrika wird meist als ein junger Kontinent wahrgenommen, da er erst seit dem 19. Jahrhundert vollständig erforscht ist. Allerdings ist er in Wirklichkeit der älteste der Kontinente, der sich schon sehr früh in der Erdgeschichte zusammengesetzt und tektonischen Spannungen lange Zeit weitgehend standgehalten hat. Der Kontinent besteht aus bis zu drei Milliarden Jahre alten Plattenformen und war vor zwei Millionen Jahren die Wiege der Menschheit.

Erdgeschichtlich gesehen ist Afrika erst seit kurzem ein eigenständiger Kontinent. Während er in seiner Frühzeit relativ stabil war, ist der afrikanische Kontinent seit einigen Millionen Jahren ständig in Bewegung und nähert sich unaufhaltsam der eurasischen Landmasse - die Kollision hat bereits begonnen.

A Japanese air crew encounters blinding lights, and a sheriff's car is engulfed by a beam of light.

It's Erin Burnett's turn to step out front and try to maintain a viable viewer presence for CNN in the weekday news arena. But the former CNBC anchor won't worry about ratings for her hourlong general news program, comparing that burden to "death." Instead, she'll concern herself with translating world events into relevant information for viewers, paying close attention to such topics as the Middle East and women's issues. "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.

Haley überdenkt ihre Karriere und die Zukunft mit Dylan. Dabei braucht sie dringend Claires mütterlichen Rat. Ihr rüder Trainingsstil bringt Jay und Cam währenddessen eine wichtige Lektion in Sensibilität von Manny und Phil ein.

pr.t: Santa Clause 2: Eine noch schönere Bescherung
pr.d: Der Nordpol versinkt im Chaos, während Santa Clause auf der Erde die perfekte Frau sucht. Außerdem muss er sich vor Ort auch um seinen Sohn kümmern, was leichter gesagt ist als getan. Währenddessen führt am Nordpol jemand anderes die Geschäfte. Ein böses Duplikat hat seine Stelle eingenommen und regiert nun ganz und gar nicht mehr im Sinne von Weihnachten. Santa Clause muss sich entscheiden, ob er seine Pflicht wahrnehmen und zum Nordpol zurückkehren will, um Weihnachten zu retten.

Der selbstverliebte Footballstar Joe Kingston steht vor einem entscheidenden Spiel, als die achtjährige Peyton an der Tür seiner Junggesellen-Designerwohnung klopft. Nach erstem Schock nimmt Joe den ungebetenen Gast, der sich als seine Tochter herausstellt, notgedrungen mit ins Trainingslager und später zur Eröffnung seines neuen Nachtclubs. Zuerst nur für eine gute Presse versucht er den liebenden Daddy zu geben.

Jess organisiert zum ersten Mal einen Tanzball an ihrer Schule, doch irgendjemand scheint den Abend sabotieren zu wollen. Weil alle Lehrerkollegen außer Coach sie im Stich lassen, ruft Jess Cece und die Männer aus der WG an, um den Ball zu retten.

Patricia ist ein freizügiges und hemmungsloses Mädchen, das auf einer erotischen Odyssee durch Griechenland reist. Ihre Eltern geben ihr ein Flugticket, um nach München zurückzukehren, wo sie ihr Studium fortsetzen soll. Stattdessen gibt sie das Ticket weg und bleibt in Griechenland. In dieser Zeit lernt sie viele Männer und Frauen kennen, mit denen sie Streiche spielt und erotische Abenteuer erlebt.

Die "Kölner" und die "Wiener", zwei rivalisierende Gangsterbanden, geraten im Köln der 60er Jahre aneinander. Nach einer Schlägerei kommt ein Mann ums Leben. Als der Bruder des Bordellbesitzers Paul Keil deshalb verhaftet wird, will er sich am ermittelnden Staatsanwalt Dr. Stauffer rächen und zettelt einen Kleinkrieg an. Währenddessen wird der Bandenkonflikt im Kölner Rotlichtmilieu immer brutaler.

Rosemary ist davon jedoch nur wenig begeistert, und als sie erfährt, dass Hollmann sie für ein verwöhntes Luxusobjekt hält, beschließt sie, ihm eine Lektion zu erteilen. In einem Fernsehstudio findet eine erhitzte Diskussion über das ungehemmte Sexualverhalten von Teenagern statt. Eine Hausfrau, eine Jugendpsychologin, ein Oberstudiendirektor und ein Kriminalkommissar besprechen ganz konkrete Fälle. Dabei geht es beispielsweise um eine 18-Jährige, deren Freundinnen ihr helfen wollen, ihre Jungfräulichkeit zu verlieren, oder um zwei junge Mädchen, bei denen es mit den ersten sexuellen Erfahrungen nicht so recht klappen will.

pr.d: Adopted as a baby, former milkman and undercover secret agent Hobbo is determined to trace his natural mother. He has found out her name and exactly where she lives, but how should he approach the poor woman to tell her the good news? Meanwhile, Howard is in trouble when Marina, upon finding out that he has been making enquiries about another woman, turns up at his house.

pr.d: Hobbo is still having trouble getting Nelly to admit that she is his natural birth mother. To get the proof he needs, he fits Howard up with an eavesdropping wire to pick up Nelly talking to Pearl. Howard does his best to look inconspicuous, but his rumbling stomach and an electronic fault on his transmitter may ruin his plans.
pr.sub: Will Howard Cross the Atlantic Single-Handed?

pr.d: NBA stars Charles Barkley and DeAndre Jordan attend the charity basketball game Phil is playing in, Gloria's nemesis tries to shame her for lack of support at Manny's school, and Claire tries to keep a work mistake secret from Jay.
Jai wed Leanne, who's scared of heights, 100 feet in the air in 2016. Now it's his turn to squirm as he sits down with his bride and her dad to relive their nuptials.

When Phil thinks Luke is giving him the cold shoulder, Andy becomes Phil's new right-hand man. Jay is put in a tough spot when it is suspected that Joe is allergic to Stella and Mitchell does some freelance legal work at Jay's company.
Claire senses that Phil may be more into 'Juliana' than into her. Gloria's sister visits. Mitchell and Cameron get into a situation with Anders.
A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister, featuring sports of the lawnmower, motorcycle and bicycle variety.
A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister, Rude(ish) Tube, featuring sports of the lawnmower, motorbike and bicycle variety.
In Northamptonshire, loved-up luvvies Anna and Coylah, sporty Felicity and Lawrence and well-to-do Martin and Dawn compete in a week featuring unthawed prawns, a panto, and limelight theft.

Gordon visits family-owned restaurant Sam's Mediterranean Kabob Room in Monrovia, California. Within minutes of his arrival, Gordon is caught in the crossfire of an argument between owner Sam, his wife and their children, all of whom are feeling the pressure of working in the restaurant seven days a week.

Gordon heads to Long Beach, California, to save Nino's, an Italian family restaurant that was opened in 1958 and is now under the misguided leadership of the eldest son, Nino. Younger brother Michael and sister Carina point the finger of blame for the restaurant's failings directly at Nino, and their 78-year-old mother Inge is desperate for Nino to turn the business around.
A little girl is tricked into cracking a raw egg on her head; kids with imaginative excuses for their misbehaviour; parents lip-sync to their kids' tantrums.
pr.sub: The Prank Bank, I'm Not Buying Your Excuse, and What Are the Odds?

pr.d: Will surprises Aunt Vivian, who is in the middle of a midlife crisis, with a birthday roast.
Will sees beyond a blind date's size to the woman within. Plus, Philip gets hooked on a home shopping channel.
Principal Skinner gives the students a blank slate and promises the best behaved among them can ride in a submarine. Meanwhile, Lisa tries to help Krusty with his financial problems.
When a leak at the power plant causes snowfall in Springfield, tourists inundate the town. Meanwhile, Marge takes on boarders to raise cash for the holidays.
Homer is thrilled to learn how to download pirated movies, and begins screening them in his backyard, but his fun ends abruptly when the FBI arrives on the scene.
When Comic Book Guy meets a woman writing an autobiographical manga, he seeks Homer's advice on dating.
Barry and Lainey's wedding date is right around the corner and Beverly is in her element, but is the groom starting to have second thoughts?
Murray and Geoff try to pull Beverly, Barry and Erica out of their shared misery after Lainey's departure. Coach Nick returns to town.

Gloria, Claire, Haley, Alex, Lily, Luke and Manny show support for gender equality and the women's movement in their own ways. Jay and Phil butt heads over their parking attendant, and Cam feels jealous when Pam prefers Mitchell's help with the baby.

Mitch and Jay end up at the same resort when they separately seek out a retreat from the family, Phil and Claire struggle to enjoy empty-nester life, and not knowing what to do with himself while Mitch is away, Cam drops in on Gloria.
The Pritchett-Dunphy-Tuckers are holidaying on a houseboat. As expected though, it's anything but relaxing.
A teary goodbye could be on the cards as Gloria and Jay move Manny into his college dorm. Haley pals up with a rich member of the country club.
Marge puts a hurtful word in Lisa's brain; Bart gets in shape.
Smithers finds true love with a famous fashion designer, but his new relationship may destroy Springfield.
pr.sub: Portrait of a Lackey on Fire

pr.d: Teenage Homer and Grampa take a road trip to look for his mum.
Fat Tony becomes Godfather to Maggie Simpson.

Homer invests all the family's money in a company that makes "Animotion" machines. After the company declares bankruptcy, Homer becomes a human guinea pig to raise some cash. The scientists find a crayon lodged in his brain and when it is removed, he suddenly becomes extremely intelligent.

The neighbouring construction site of a new golf course causes issues at Abbott, forcing the teachers to find creative solutions; an HR representative visits the school; following their kiss, Janine and Gregory's relationship status is revealed.
Brand new series - Back to School: Another school year, another series... A neighbouring construction site causes issues at Abbott. And are Janine and Gregory finally an item?!

After Hilary appears in traffic court, part of her sentence includes several hours of community service at the Southside Free Clinic, where she meets handsome doctor Alec Hudson. Meanwhile, Jazz becomes a butler.

When Will comes down with tonsillitis, his family book him into hospital for surgery. He meets an 80-year-old stand-up comic whose jokes about death make Will so nervous that he decides to escape. Plus, Geoffrey's pending book worries the Banks family.
This week the Goggleboxers watched 'Race Across the World', 'The Apprentice', 'Ripley', 'MasterChef', 'Hunted', 'Celebrity Bridge of Lies', 'The Assembly' and BBC News (Hardest Geezer).

The First Dates restaurant opens its doors to more hopeful singletons from all over the country, including Liverpool lass Alex whose date is trade union rep Sam, and three-time divorced Zina who is trying her luck with undertaker to the stars Chris.
A self-destructing task keeps the comedians guessing. Other challenges involve a meal with a nesting doll theme and a team attempt at a stealthy escape.
The second of a two-part compilation of all the best bits from this series of 8 out of 10 Cats. Host Jimmy Carr and team captain, Rob Beckett, are joined by a host of famous faces.
The second half of a two-part compilation of all the best bits from series 21, with Jimmy Carr, Rob Beckett, Aisling Bea, Katherine Ryan, Richard Osman, Sara Pascoe, Oti Mabuse and more.
Jimmy Carr hosts a brand new show, as Sean Lock and Joe Wilkinson take on Jon Richardson and Harriet Kemsley. Plus James Veitch is in Dictionary Corner.
A self-destructing task keeps the comedians guessing. Other challenges involve a meal with a nesting doll theme and a team attempt at a stealthy escape.
Bringing the best in television.
Teleshopping
Teleshopping
The director of the world's largest hardware chain True Value Store in Texas, John Hartmann, goes undercover with his own staff. He wants to discover how he can further improve the company.
Pittsburgh Mayor Bill Peduto tackles undercover roles of municipal employees including a refuse worker, a carpenter and a self-sufficiency coordinator.
First up in the West Midlands are free spirits Michelle and Carl, who get all Zen over their home-grown produce. They're joined by Katie and Phil, and Petra and her Italian husband Sergio.
Mike and Lisa kick off the competition in Worcester with an Italian-themed menu. Linda and Steve opt for a completely homemade menu, and married couple Paul and Paul take a risk.

Magician Jack has just three weeks and £12,000 to pull off the perfect wedding for Sarah. Jack wants to put on his biggest magic show ever for his wedding day, while all Sarah wants is one day in her life when she can be the centre of attention.
pr.sub: The One with All the Magic

pr.d: Amy dreams of a peaceful day close to home with all her friends and family around her, but Josh has big plans for an ambitious beach wedding abroad, all to make up for a disastrous holiday he organised that left Amy reaching for the sick bucket.
The King of Montebello can't wait to see what he can drum up this time around. Rene sniffs out a great locker, stepping over the competition to get it. Kenny does his best to fire up his profits.

Back in Montebello, Brandi and her buddy set the Wayback Machine and discover a roaring good time. Darrell makes the most of the little he's got. And Kenny fills his piggy bank, while courting an unfamiliar pastime.
Peavey Electronics COO Courtland Gray goes undercover to learn more about how his audio empire operates.
When Vivint CEO Todd Pedersen goes undercover, he struggles with his fear of heights and the pressures of the job.

Kids who don't understand old technology; a teen doesn't know how to insert a letter into a public mailbox; two kids try to figure out what a telephone jack is; twins blame each other for flooding a bathroom.
pr.sub: Influencer Flubs, and Young People and Old Technology

pr.d: Ivy confuses profit with prophet, but still manages to climb his way to success. Kenny tries to honour the history of San Bernardino, recording a win along the way. Brandi shows her literary prowess volume by volume.

It's a regular father and son shootout in Victorville, as Ivy and Pops try to prove who among them is the most profitable. Brandi's secret weapon lands her more than she bargained for but luckily, Kenny is there to brighten her day.

Fraser must deal with escalating tension between two of his stews that threatens to ruin his season. Jared makes a big mistake, causing Ben and Fraser to feel that they can't rely on the new bosun. Captain Kerry docks St David for the first time.
An over-the-top guest has the crew scrambling all over the place. Meanwhile, Captain Jason's resolved to keep his distance. Wise move, skip...

Gordon heads to the Prohibition Grille in Everett, Washington, where he meets a belly dancer-turned-restaurateur named Rishi Brown. As a boss, Rishi is making all the wrong moves and her lack of experience is evident everywhere.

Gordon heads to country music's spiritual home, Nashville, Tennessee, but his visit begins on a sour note at Chappy's Cajun restaurant. Chef John 'Chappy' Chapman's careless methods have hurt his local reputation.
Katherine Ryan hosts a special, celebrating 100 years of women's suffrage. Roisin Conaty and Jessica Hynes go against Sara Pascoe and Lolly Adefope. Also featuring Morgana Robinson, Susie and Rachel.
Jimmy Carr hosts the popular panel show, as Sean Lock and Michelle Wolf take on Jon Richardson and Rob Beckett. Plus Spencer Jones is in Dictionary Corner.
Taskmaster Greg Davies is impressed by Charlotte Ritchie's snack-munching methods and Jamali Maddix shows off his pretty wings as the race to win Greg's shiny skull-trophy continues.
David's feisty keeper doesn't like Natalie's flirting. And David's day gets worse when he receives several cold shoulders due to his indecision. There's a shock at the elimination.
Rebecca's tired of guys with bad boy images breaking her heart. Dan thinks the only thing missing in his life's the love of a good man. Can they find love the Naked Attraction way?
Britain's sharpest armchair critics watch The Apprentice, Hunted, Corrie, The Underdog: Josh Must Win, Bridge of Lies, and the News on the Princess of Wales' cancer diagnosis.
The Goggleboxers tune in to Gladiators, Is It Cake?, Casualty, The 1% Club, The Yorkshire Farm, This Morning, BBC News on the cost of living, and more.
Brand new series - Party: Ahead of the summer vacation, Janine throws the perfect end-of-year party for her colleagues and friends. Series finale.
Bohemian Rap City: Beverly and Murray are worried about Adam's obsession with toys. Erica's band decide to audition for a TV talent show.
The Living Room: A 100% True Story: Barry's worried about Murray's health, so he asks his friends and Coach Mellor to help him get fit.
Basketball!: Phil's been doing basketball training so that he can redeem himself at the annual charity game. Then NBA stars Charles Barkley and DeAndre Jordan turn up...
Jai married Leanne - who's scared of heights - 100 feet in the air. Now it's his turn to squirm as he sits down with his bride and her dad to relive their nuptials.
Rash Decisions: Phil feels the teenage cold shoulder from Luke, and Andy - who's been hanging around a lot as Phil's apprentice - steps in as his new right-hand man.
Valentine's Day 4: Twisted Sister: On Valentine's Day, Claire is worried that Phil may be more into her alter-ego Juliana than her.
A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister, Rude(ish) Tube, featuring sports of the lawnmower, motorbike and bicycle variety.
In Northamptonshire, there are unthawed prawns, a crowd-pleasing panto and limelight theft, as luvvies Anna and Coylah, sporty Felicity and Lawrence, and well-to-do Martin and Dawn compete.
Sam's Mediterranean Kabob Room: In California, Gordon visits Sam's Mediterranean Kabob Room, where he tries to mend relationships between the owner, his wife and their children.
Nino's: Gordon visits Long Beach in California to save Nino's, a failing Italian restaurant that opened in 1958 and is now under the misguided leadership of eldest son Nino.
Alfonso Ribeiro hosts as home video clips capture funny, surprising and memorable moments, including parents lip-syncing perfectly in time to their children's tantrums!
The Big Four-Oh: When Vivian turns 40, she becomes obsessed with achieving her lifelong dream of being a professional dancer.
She Ain't Heavy: Will takes the shallow way out when his friends tease him about his date (guest star Queen Latifah).
Yellow Subterfuge: Bart becomes a model student so that he can go on a school trip on a submarine. But Principal Skinner has other ideas...
White Christmas Blues: When radioactive steam from the nuclear power plant mixes with pollution, snow falls over Springfield and the town is inundated with holiday revellers.
Steal This Episode: Irked by high cinema ticket prices, Homer starts screening pirated movies in his back garden. But the FBI soon catch up with him...
Married to the Blob: Comic Book Guy asks Homer for advice on how to woo cute comic fan Kumiko, who visits his shop to research material for an autobiographical manga.
The Wedding Singer: Beverly's excited about Barry and Lainey's impending nuptials, but is the groom starting to have second thoughts?
The Pina Colada Episode: Murray and Geoff try to pull Beverly, Barry and Erica out of their shared misery after Lainey's departure. Coach Nick returns to town.
All Things Being Equal: Gloria, Claire, Haley, Alex, Lily, Luke and Manny each have very different ways of supporting gender equality.
Alone Time: Everyone deserves a little alone time, but when Mitch and Jay separately seek out a much-needed retreat from the family, they end up at the same resort.
Lake Life: Jay makes the family take their holiday on a houseboat to create memories that will last long after he's gone. And Mitchell runs into an old flame.
The Long Goodbye: Phil and Claire realise that Alex is more self-sufficient in college than they thought. Manny is determined to avoid a tearful goodbye when he moves to college.
Lisa's Belly: Bart and Lisa have to take steroids after getting an infection at a waterpark - and the new drugs have some alarming side effects, particularly for Lisa.
Portrait of a Lackey on Fire: Smithers tires of Mr Burns' indifference and finds solace in the arms of affectionate fashion designer Michael de Graaf.
Mothers and Other Strangers: Homer does therapy to cope with missing his mother, sending him on a trip down memory lane, to when he and Grampa went on a road trip to find her.
A Made Maggie: Marge sends Homer to find a godfather for an as-yet-unbaptised Maggie. And who'd make a better godfather than mafia don Fat Tony?
Homr: When Homer loses all the family's money with an unwise investment, he becomes a human guinea pig to earn some cash - and that's when he becomes extremely intelligent...
Brand new series - Back to School: Another school year, another series... A neighbouring construction site causes issues at Abbott. And are Janine and Gregory finally an item?!
Community Action: Thanks to her many traffic violations, Hilary is ordered to do community service at a medical clinic, where she immediately falls in love with the doctor.
Ill Will: While he's in hospital for a tonsillectomy, Will learns to look at life a little differently from his wisecracking wardmate, Max (guest star Milton Berle).
On the 'Box this time: Race Across the World, The Apprentice, Ripley, MasterChef, Hunted, Celebrity Bridge of Lies, The Assembly and endurance athlete Hardest Geezer.
Matthew has been to Disneyland 43 times, but hasn't yet met his Prince Charming. Can fellow Disney fanatic Paul give him his happy ever after?
Tensions between Natalie and David are at an all-time high as they both leave the latest elimination alone. David's desperate to squash their beef, but Natalie's not so sure...

After a tense starter course, the chefs return to the kitchen to cook their fish dishes. James is making his elevated take on a fried chicken takeaway as a tribute to the NHS staff who care for his sister. Shauna is also taking inspiration from a personal connection with a tribute to staff from a facility in her hometown of Londonderry. Tommy is hoping to impress with a dish dedicated to the discovery of DNA.

With two courses down it's time for the chefs to cook their main courses. It's the battle of beef with each using the same meat in their innovative creations. Tommy also meets the first baby ever born on the NHS.

It's the dessert course and the final chance for the chefs to impress. After such a tightly fought battle all week, each is hoping to deliver a technically perfect dessert. Tommy and James are both using passion fruit in their complex dishes while Shauna is hoping to use her pastry chef training to score full marks.

The two chefs representing Northern Ireland go head-to-head. Judging as ever are Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort and Andi Oliver who are joined by Shehan Hettiaratchy, lead trauma surgeon at St Mary's Hospital who helped treat victims of the Grenfell Tower fire.

The winning chefs from all eight regions must battle it out for the honour of a spot on 2018's 'Feast To Say Thank You' banquet menu, celebrating 70 years of the NHS, one of Britain's most prized institutions.

The chefs must prepare fish courses, and after some exceptionally high-scoring dishes in the starter round, everyone is desperate to deliver perfection. Once again, the chefs present their innovative, witty and heart-warming creations.

It's main course day and with only two spots remaining on the banquet menu, the competition is fierce. Both chefs and judges alike are amazed at the high standard of cooking and an incredible number of 10s are dished out as the chefs serve up venison, rabbit, duck, beef, lamb and pork for scrutiny.

It's dessert day and with just one place remaining at the banquet feast, each chef is giving everything they've got for a chance to say thank you to the heroic NHS staff. All the chefs have significantly re-worked or re-invented their desserts since the regional heats, proving that they'll do everything they can in a bid for that final winning spot.

It's the grand finale as the winning chefs cook their dishes at a banquet for the heroes of the NHS. Having arrived at St Bartholomew's Hospital, the chefs are shown the incredible location for event, the almost three-hundred-year-old Great Hall.
Competing for the top spot are 3 new chefs to the competition representing some of the most exciting culinary talent from London, Paul Walsh, Luke Selby and Ben Marks.

pr.d: The three chefs are halfway through their heat and the pressure is mounting. Only two will proceed to Friday's judging and have a chance to represent the London and the South East region at the regional finals.

pr.d: The two remaining London chefs must cook their four-course menus again. The chefs need to impress the formidable judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

Three chefs new to the competition compete in the North East heats. Three of the region's chefs battle it out for the top spot: Mike Carr, Samira Effa, and Tom Anglesea. The three chefs must present the menu of their careers, inspired by 50 years of British pop music.

pr.d: The chefs are halfway through their heat and will serve up their main courses and desserts. The stakes are high, and again they are each serving a unique take on the pop music brief. Mike is confident about his northern dish, 'Rack n Roll', which puts both classic Yorkshire hogget and traditional Lancashire hotpot in the spotlight.

The two remaining North East chefs must cook their four-course menus again for the judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the British pop industry's finest.

Newcomer Kray brings an urban edge to proceedings, with a starter inspired by grime music called 'Fire in the Booth'. It combines hot sauce, veal sweetbreads and tuna belly. Returner Sabrina is compiling a dish of her favourite ingredients, including pasta and ox cheek, for her Italian inspired starter called 'My Mixtape'.

For his main course, Ryan Simpson-Trotman is confident his dish, `The UK's Number 1', will hit the top spot with his combination of a beef pie and rump cap. Sabrina Gidda is taking inspiration from her grandad's collection of old 45s for her `Sunday Jukebox' main: pork Wellington and Black Country faggots.
The two remaining Central chefs must cook their four-course menus again for judges food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

Competing for a place on the banquet menu are two chefs returning to the competition for a second time, plus a supremely talented newcomer. Liam Simpson, who co-owns a high-end gastropub near Henley-on-Thames, is hoping to make it all the way after being knocked out in the heats during the 2018 competition.

The chefs are halfway through the regional heats and, as the lowest scoring chef will be eliminated from the competition at the end of the show, the pressure is on. They start by cooking their all-important main courses, the centrepiece of the banquet menu. Michelin-starred newcomer Hrishikesh Desai is pushing himself to the limit with a complex multipart venison dish, inspired by the bands which play at the Kendal Calling music festival.

The two remaining chefs from the north-west cook their dishes head to head for a panel of expert judges, in a bid to secure themselves a place in the national finals. Will they have acted on the advice given by the veteran judge earlier in the week, and learn from their mistakes?

Three of Scotland's finest chefs do battle for a chance to cook at the banquet celebrating 50 Years of Popular Music. Gordon Jones, the only newcomer, faces returners Lorna McNee and Ben Reade, who are going head-to-head for the second time.

The chefs cook their mains and desserts, each battling to produce smash hit dishes that wow their veteran. For her main, Lorna is confident her lamb dish `With A Little Help From My Friends', dedicated to supportive friends, is a celebratory dish fit for the banquet.

The two remaining Scottish chefs must cook their four courses again, but this time they'll need to appeal to four new palates. Food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton, broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver plus a celebrity guest judge.

Emily Scott is the chef proprietor of Cornwall's renowned 'St Tudy Inn'. Her two rivals are from across the sea on Jersey. Joe Baker is largely self-taught, but at just 28 already running his own restaurant, 'No 10', in St Helier. A neighbouring restaurant is Michelin starred 'Samphire' where Lee Smith is head chef.

Emily's David Bowie-inspired dish celebrates Britain's food heroes, and she uses Cornish duck meat from her local producer that she pairs with grilled radicchio and Malbec sauce. Meanwhile, Joe has also sourced his ingredients locally.

Paranormal investigator Erin Goodpipe tries to see who haunts Old Arnold Estate.
pr.sub: Who is Haunting the Old Arnold Estate?

pr.d: While investigating an attempted robbery, a police officer encounters a terrifying shadow. Plus, a paramedic witnesses the possession of a teenager, while an EMT is horrified when a ghost hitches a ride in her ambulance.
pr.sub: Demon Teen; Dark Shadows; Paranormal Plaza

pr.d: A firefighter experiences ghostly phenomena at an amusement park. A police officer encounters a dark entity that may be the cause of multiple fatalities on a notoriously dangerous stretch of highway known as the Coffin Corridor.

A police officer faces a paranormal nightmare when he responds to a 911 call from a distressed homeowner; a first responder questions his sanity after he sees the ghost of a young accident victim in his home.

A terrifying creature with 1,000 teeth torments Allison Gilson's son; a young boy makes an imaginary friend but discovers it's not the only entity lurking in their new home; a ghost uses a boy to get to his mother.

A poltergeist haunts Kristine McKee's new home and gets physical with her son; a friend's past life comes back to haunt Danielle Low with potentially life-threatening results; a paranormal entity attacks a woman, leaving her black and blue.
An evil spirit tells Dawn Whitehair to get out of her home, and an entity tormenting a family possesses the medium they brought in to help to convey a chilling message.
Chasing the echoes of a departed dad's spirit that is lingering at home.

For years, Susan has grappled with the untimely deaths of her brother and nephew. The phenomena she experienced before their passing seem almost like a macabre foreshadowing of the torment she still feels as a result of their loss.

Angelique, an Espiritismo practitioner, discovers that her deep bond with her aunt may extend beyond the grave. This connection possibly links her to the terrifying premonitions of death she receives about those closest to her.

Since childhood, Mandy has been visited by departed loved ones, often in terrifying circumstances. This compelled her to explore paranormal research, leading to the discovery of her mediumship abilities.
Leitreanna, a lifelong practitioner of Seminole spiritualism, believes her departed father visited her during an excruciating operation. She saw him comforting her whilst she was in blinding pain.

Stacy began to mend the relationship she had with her mum following her cancer diagnosis. Her mother succumbed to her illness. She believes a number of paranormal occurrences are a testament to the love they have for each other.

Jessica recounts how as a child, she was visited nightly by Abraham Lincoln and a woman in a herringbone dress. She was shocked, however, to learn the true identities of these figures after her mother cracked open a family album.
George helps his sister with a dark and malevolent spirit; a group of teens mistakenly unleash a demon; an investigator spends the night in a church rectory with a dark past.
During an investigation of a Chicago cemetery, Ursula endures the most terrifying time of her life; George is asked to remove a spirit that's attacking a young boy.

In Ontario cottage country, an investigator is stalked by a terrifying beast-like entity; in Ohio, Karlo and his team are frozen in fear when they come face to face with the ghost of an executioner on an old jail's death row.
Michelle Desrochers' dream trip to Transylvania turns into a nightmare, while in New York, paranormal investigators are attacked by a dangerous entity stalking an old church.
Step inside spooky Ashmore Estates and uncover a haunting with a purpose.
Find a shocking connection in a theatre plagued by paranormal activity.

pr.t: Unsettled History: America, China and the Doolittle Tokyo Raid
pr.d: Examining the Doolittle Raid on Tokyo from the perspectives of the children of the Doolittle Raiders and Chinese villagers who aided in their rescue.

pr.t: Hitler's 9/11 - The Secret War on America
pr.d: A look at Hitler's bold plan during World War Two to send fighter planes into Manhattan skyscrapers for the psychological impact it would cause on the citizens in the United States and the world as a whole.
The unique stories of ten very different people who were caught up in the liberation of Europe from the grip of Nazi terror are interwoven.
The stories of 10 very different people who were caught up in the liberation of Europe from the grip of Nazi Germany during the Second World War.

Lieutenant Sander undertakes an arduous journey to Leningrad, revealing the harsh German east campaign of 'Operation Barbarossa'. He notes down his experiences in a diary that provides us a look at the attack on the Soviet Union.

Lieutenant Sander undertakes an arduous journey to Leningrad, revealing the harsh German east campaign of 'Operation Barbarossa'. He notes down his experiences in a diary that provides us a look at the attack on the Soviet Union.

On 6 June 1944, Allied forces undertook the largest air, land and sea invasion in history. On D-Day, more than 150,000 Allied troops stormed five assault beaches in Normandy, attempting to break through Hitler's Atlantic Wall.

pr.t: Wings: World War Two in the Skies
pr.d: In the early days of WWII, pilots and engineers fight to win the battle of the skies. They use Spitfires, Hurricanes, Zeros, Hellcats, Oscars, ME 109s and Flying Fortresses.

pr.t: Wings: World War Two in the Skies
pr.d: The Hell Hawks fight D-Day in the air. The Avenger torpedo plane blows Japan's largest battleship out of the water. Nazi super-weapons bring terror from above.
Technological innovations in U.S. naval aviation change the face of war.
Technological innovations in U.S. Navy aviation change the face of war.

pr.t: Unsettled History: America, China and the Doolittle Tokyo Raid
pr.d: Examining the Doolittle Raid on Tokyo from the perspectives of the children of the Doolittle Raiders and Chinese villagers who aided in their rescue.

Telling the story of the Battle of Quebec, 1759, where at stake was the future of North America and the fate of the British Empire. Britain used its growing industrial strength and a new scientific approach to fight a campaign unlike any that had gone before. It launched a fleet of 200 ships carrying 20,000 men on a deadly mission through uncharted waters.
On April 6, 1862, the Confederate force's surprise attack against the Union in Shiloh, Tenn., results in some of the most brutal fighting of the Civil War.

Gen. Ulysses S. Grant's counter-attack at Shiloh, Tenn., leads to victory; thousands of escaping slaves seek refuge with Union forces advancing into the South; President Abraham Lincoln begins drafting a proclamation addressing slavery and freedom.

The Emancipation Proclamation ends slavery and gives blacks the freedom to fight; on July 4, 1863, the day after Pickett's Charge at Gettysburg, the Confederates surrender Vicksburg, Miss., to Gen. Grant.

The Confederate Army of Northern Virginia succeeds at splitting the Union Army in two during the Battle of Chickamauga; Gen. William Rosecrans is replaced by Gen. Ulysses S. Grant, who plans an offensive.
The Confederate Army falls to a defensive position in Atlanta; President Abraham Lincoln defeats challenger George McClellan; Sherman's March to the Sea.
Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. Pre-Pearl Harbour, the US helped democracies and men joined the army to prepare for WW2 and Japan's threat.

Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. In 1942 the US had victories in the Doolittle Raid, Coral Sea and Midway while the Nazi's were taking Europe.

Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. Have a look at WW2 in 1943, where the battle turned against North Africa and plans were laid to bomb Germany.
Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. In 1944, the US waged global war towards Rome and the Pacific, and 6 June marked the D-Day landings.
The Battle of the Bulge continued in 1945 and the US battled stiff resistance on Leyte and Iwo Jima.
A 1943 film introduces American soldiers to Britain and tells them what to expect, how to behave and how not to behave in Britain during World War II.

The death of the Queen's uncle, Prince George, Duke of Kent, in a plane crash in 1942 has never been fully explained. The mysterious circumstances surrounding the crash has led to accusations that the Prince has been airbrushed from history.
King Ludwig of Bavaria's unstable behaviour saw him deposed from the throne in 1886. Days later, he was found dead. Was it suicide or murder?
pr.sub: King Ludwig II: The Mad King of Bavaria

pr.d: The final words of a lifelong gold hunter send Adam, Kru and Daryl Friesen through an icy gauntlet high above Pitt Lake.
An old map connected to testimony from an 1891 eyewitness account of Slumach's hanging sheds light on the legend.
In Cheltenham, Britain's most Regency town, Professor Alice Roberts attends a period society ball, investigates social hierarchy and explores the Regency fondness for enemas.
In Belfast, the UK's most Victorian city, Alice Roberts visits the shipyards that built the Titanic, gets locked up in the Crumlin Road gaol and learns about 19th-century etiquette.
Andy embarks on a mission to unearth the Cornish sites of King Arthur, before magnet fishing for Excalibur and visiting the grave of a legendary witch.

Professor Alice Roberts explores the English Civil War through the history of Oxford, the city at the heart of a battle between an autocratic king and his rebellious parliament. Oxford became the power base for Charles I and his royalist supporters.

Finds include: revelations from 'Britain's Pompeii', the 3,000-year-old perfectly preserved village in Cambridgeshire, including how Bronze Age ancestors designed their homes, and their kitchens packed with food and equipment, and the theatre where Shakespeare premiered Romeo and Juliet and Henry V.

A look at the camp from which Vikings invaded Britain, and groundbreaking evidence that the world-famous Avebury stone circle isn't just a sacred site but a place where people lived and worked. In Staffordshire, the oldest Iron Age gold in Britain is unearthed.
pr.sub: Viking Camp And Iron Age Gold

pr.d: Colourized rare archival film and home movies brings Churchill back to life. Includes moments of drama, alongside playful scenes with Charlie Chaplin and Churchill losing his shorts in his swimming pool.

Colourisation of historic film creates a vivid portrait of the Royal Family from the late 19th century onwards. Includes the earliest film of Queen Victoria, and Edward and Wallis Simpson marrying in exile.

Alice visits Canterbury for the story of Plantagenet England. Canterbury is steeped in history and the era of the Plantagenets - the strong house that held the English throne from 1154 until 1485 - saw the most dramatic episodes in the city's story.
Alice Roberts explores the story of Stewart Britain by visiting Stirling, the home of the Scottish royals who eventually took the English throne in 1603 and created Great Britain.
Andy is back in Cornwall searching for legends, meeting a real-life mermaid and fishing for Cornwall's infamous sea serpent Morgawr.
Andy explores an ancient cavern, takes a tour of Dartmoor's prison museum and uncovers the legend behind Arthur Conan Doyle's 'The Hound of the Baskervilles'.

In the North, the remains of a Tudor house in Leicestershire were thought to be the childhood home of England's forgotten Queen, Lady Jane Grey. But when archaeologists excavate, they find more than they bargained for.

Find out how a lobster led archaeologists to the discovery of an 8,000-year-old Neolithic underwater settlement. Join a team at a secret location in Dorset as they excavate an Iron Age crouched burial and in London's East End, location reporter Naoise Mac Sweeney visits a modern construction site as it gives up the secrets of an Elizabethan playhouse.

Edinburgh's handsome hilltop bastion is Scotland's most popular paid tourist attraction. With a slew of sieges to its name, it is no surprise that the site boasts some formidable defences, and Dan puts one heavy-duty cannon through its paces.

Dan Jones explores the history of Cardiff Castle over more than 2,000 years and reveals how it became transformed from a strategically important Roman and Norman stronghold to a lavish fairy-tale Victorian home.

Professor Alice Roberts explores the English Civil War through the history of Oxford, the city at the heart of a battle between an autocratic king and his rebellious parliament. Oxford became the power base for Charles I and his royalist supporters.

Professor Alice Roberts tells the story of Edwardian Britain by visiting Cardiff, which grew rich selling the coal that powered the Empire. Alice hears the stories of the Edwardian miners and their backbreaking and often dangerous work.
From Ancient Egypt and the rule of the pharaohs to Anglo-Saxon England, uncover the origins of the curses surrounding the bust of Nefertiti, the Staffordshire Hoard, and more.

The hunt leads to Anglo-Saxon England, medieval Europe, China under its first Emperor, and Egypt when the pharaohs still ruled, where the origins of the curses surrounding the Staffordshire Hoard, Black Prince's Ruby, and more are uncovered.

Looking at attitudes to sex before the intervention of Christianity. Amanda trains as a Spartan woman and then discovers the influence of the Kama Sutra today, while Dan visits Chelsea Physic Garden to recreate Ancient Egyptian sexual medicines.

Amanda and Dan tackle the Tudor and Stuart period. Dan dons a full suit of armour before mounting his steed and learning how to joust, while Amanda learns the dance that was getting Elizabethan society hot and bothered, the La Volta.

Nach einer Transplantation kämpft Elektriker Frank mit den strukturellen Mängeln seines Hauses, die ein früherer Auftragnehmer hinterlassen hat. Die Familie Holmes nimmt sich des Projekts an und setzt alles daran, das Haus sicher für Frank zu machen.
Jonathan und Drew gestalten für Laurences Freund ein Refugium im Hinterhof auf Resortniveau.

Der Hollywoodstar Andy Garcia möchte seinem verstorbenen Freund Julio mit einem Geschenk die letzte Ehre erweisen, das seine Familie nie vergessen wird, und verwandelt die alte Garage und die Terrasse im Hinterhof in ein einladendes Gästehaus.
Als alleinerziehende Mutter von vier Söhnen hat eine Frau lange drei Jobs gleichzeitig gestemmt. Dann gewinnt sie mit einem Rubbellos fünf Millionen Dollar und ihr Leben verändert sich schlagartig.
Nach einer Erbschaft möchte ein Paar in ein Feriendomizil investieren, das an die verstorbene Mutter, den Vater und den Bruder der Frau erinnert.

Ein Paar hat in einer Lotterie den großen Coup gelandet und plant seinen Ruhestand. Das neue Zuhause soll an der Küste von Pamlico Sound in North Carolina liegen. David Bromstad soll dort eine geeignete Luxusimmobilie finden.

John und Laura gewinnen kurz nach ihrer Verlobung eine Million US-Dollar in der Lotterie. Aus diesem Grund wollen sie sich eine neue Bleibe kaufen. Diese soll historischen Charme haben. Der Immobilienfachmann David Bromstad soll unterstützen.

Michael gewinnt 100.000 Dollar und nur fünf Wochen später weitere 750.000 Dollar. Zuerst kauft Michael seiner Tochter und ihrer Familie ein Haus in North Carolina. Anschließend sucht er nach einem Stadthaus für sich in der Nähe seiner Tochter.

Für einen professionellen Pokerprofi soll David Bromstad ein riesiges Familienanwesen entlang der Main Line von Philadelphia finden. Die Immobilie soll modern und einzigartig sein. Der Kunde hat extrem hohe Ansprüche an die Ästhetik.

Eine dreiköpfige Familie sucht nach einem Tiny House in McKinney, Texas, um mehr Zeit miteinander zu verbringen. Bei der Gestaltung des neuen Zuhauses kommt es zu Auseinandersetzungen, da der Boho- und Blockhausstil zur Auswahl liegen.

Jenny wünscht sich ein Tiny Hexenhäuschen, das mit 28 Quadratmetern alles bieten soll. Sie ist als Flugbegleiterin viel unterwegs und ihr reicht ein kleines Haus für maximale Flexibilität. Das Tiny House soll dabei hell sein mit großen Fenstern.

Ein Paar aus Phoenix verkleinert sich von seinem Zuhause auf ein Tiny House. Dieses ist ein Sechstel der Größe ihres vorherigen Hauses, damit einen weniger stressender und überladener Lebensstil für die beiden möglich ist.

Rob und Tami suchen ein Tiny House in Colorado, nachdem ihre Kinder aus dem Haus sind. Mit knapp 75.000 US-Dollar wollen sie es sich gemütlich einrichten, aber müssen auch Kompromisse eingehen, ob sie lieber etwas Modernes oder Rustikales möchten.

Ein frisch verlobtes Paar ist in seiner Heimat Australien auf der Suche nach dem nächsten Abenteuer. Die Vielgereisten müssen sich nur noch entscheiden, ob sie ein Haus an der Cooloola-Küste oder in der wilden Natur bevorzugen.

Als Frances ihren Job in Arizona verliert, beschließt sie, dass sie in der modernen Metropole Shenzhen in China Englisch unterrichten will. Doch sie hat Schwierigkeiten, sich mit den kleinen Wohnungen abzufinden, die es in ihrer Preisklasse gibt.

Sheila tritt eine neue Stelle im belgischen Hainaut an. Ihr Freund Andy hilft ihr bei der Wohnungssuche. Während Sheila zwischen dem Leben in der Innenstadt und in der Nähe des Stützpunkts hin- und hergerissen ist, hat Andy fixe Ideen.

Die junge Köchin Flora möchte mehr über die nordthailändische Küche erfahren. Sie beschließt, in die Heimatstadt ihres Mannes Note, Chiang Mai, zu ziehen. Sie möchte unbedingt in das authentische Leben Thailands eintauchen.

Ein frisch verlobtes Paar, das Philadelphia noch nie verlassen oder zusammen unter einem Dach gelebt hat, zieht wegen eines Jobangebots nach Sydney. Das neue Leben in einem anderen Land stellt ihre Beziehung auf die Probe.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Ein Rubbellos hat der Kunsthandwerkerin Sandy Freiheit gegeben. Sie kann die Zweizimmerwohnung in Florida verlassen, die sie bisher mit ihrem Sohn geteilt hat, und sich ein eigenes Haus suchen. Der Junior (32) kann die bisherige Wohnung behalten.
Die aufstrebende Musikerin Nicole bereitet sich darauf vor, sich in Nashville niederzulassen.

Ein Paar bereitet sich darauf vor, in Nashville, Tennessee, Wurzeln zu schlagen, nachdem es wegen eines Traumjobs umgezogen ist. Drew leitet die Suche nach einem Juwel aus der Mitte des Jahrhunderts, während Jonathan mit einer Renovierung beginnt.
Um sich ihren Traum vom Strandhaus zu erfüllen, schaut sich eine Familie in Surfside Beach um.
Eine Familie ist auf der Suche nach einem Haus, das zum neuen Zuhause werden soll.
Eine Familie findet ein Haus, das renoviert werden muss. Sie haben ehrgeizige Pläne für das Haus.

Tamara hilft einem jungen Ehepaar, einen riesigen Anbau an ihr wunderschönes historisches Haus mit historischem Design zu versehen. Durch die Kombination von Alt und Neu erhält das Anwesen alles, was es für weitere 100 Jahre braucht.

Tamara hilft einem Investor, eine abgewohnte Villa in eine goldene Mietimmobilie zu verwandeln. Das schöne Anwesen erhält ein komplettes Facelifting, von der Veranda bis zum Pool, und wird zu einem Traumhaus für den Urlaub.

Tamara und ihr Team verwandeln das verwunschene Gebäude mit viel Liebe zum Detail in ein Zuhause voller Fantasie. Versteckte Elemente, aufwendige Gestaltung und eine klare Vision lassen aus Chaos ein echtes Traumhaus entstehen.
Peter Walsh hilft einem Witwer, sich von der Puppensammlung seiner verstorbenen Frau zu trennen.
Sie quetschen sich in Harrys und Annas Rumpelkammer, die sie seit Jahren nicht mehr betreten haben.

Jack reist nach Nevada, wo sich hinter der Fassade eines unscheinbaren Hauses ein Piratenschatz verbirgt. Danach besucht er ein außergewöhnliches Wohnhaus auf einer Brücke und entdeckt zum Abschluss in New Orleans ein Haus mit bewegter Vergangenheit.

Jack beginnt seine Reise in Nebraska mit einem aufwendig renovierten Raketensilo. Anschließend besichtigt er ein märchenhaftes Cottage mit Hollywood-Bezug und besucht zum Abschluss in Las Vegas ein außergewöhnliches Paradies für Autofans.

In Santa Barbara steht ein Haus, dessen Gestaltung von der Unterwasserwelt inspiriert ist. Danach geht es nach Nebraska zu einem außergewöhnlichen Gebäude aus Metall und Glas. In Las Vegas gibt es ein Wohnhaus ganz im Stil von Comic-Helden.

Die Reise beginnt in Lake Las Vegas mit einem Anwesen im europäischen Stil. Danach führt sie ihn nach Nebraska zu einem architektonischen „Googie"-Klassiker und endet an den Stränden von Destin in Florida, wo ein echtes Wohnhighlight wartet.

Nachdem sie das Schlimmste vom Schlimmsten ausgewählt hat, gibt Retta bekannt, welches hässliche Haus von der Designerin Alison Victoria für 150.000 Dollar renoviert wird. Die Hausbesitzer werden die erstaunliche Verwandlung sehen.
Inmitten der Berge Amerikas findet Retta drei hässliche Häuser, die einer Renovierung bedürfen.
pr.sub: Realer Irrsinn in den Rocky Mountains

pr.d: Retta macht sich auf den Weg in den Sunshine State, um sich ein Anwesen anzusehen.

Der Motorradverkäufer Josh gewinnt mit einem Rubbellos fünf Millionen Dollar. Damit will er sich einen Wunsch erfüllen und sich ein Haus mit großem Grundstück in Kalifornien kaufen, wo es Platz für seine Familie, für Tiere und Motorräder gibt.

Angela und Rey aus Richmond, Virginia, wollen von einem Teil ihres Gewinns von einer Million Dollar ein Ferienhaus am Meer mit viel Platz kaufen. Dort wollen sie dann mit ihren Töchtern und Enkeln ihren Ruhestand genießen.

While developers in Croydon in Surrey and Donnington in Shropshire wrestle with whether to lose a bedroom each for a better placed kitchen or bathroom, two friends in Derby consider creating two more in their six-bedroom house.

Two brothers buy a rundown cottage in Probus in Cornwall, a father buys a flat in Mitcham in Surrey as a long-term investment for his young daughter and a seasoned property developer buys a house in Tunstall in Stoke-on-Trent for her daughter.

Dion is in Plaistow in London looking around a three-bedroom semi, Lucy is checking out a small piece of land in Crayford in Kent, and Martin meets a father and son who have bought a small house with a big garden in Wheelock in Cheshire.
A former miner's cottage in Aberaman in South Wales and semis in Adderley Green in Stoke and Streatham in South London are all sold under the hammer.
Martin, Lucy and Dion look around auction buys in Birmingham, Oldham and Gravesend and discover what the new owners plan to do with their investments.
Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin are in Stoke, Croydon in London and Warrington hearing tales from the auction rooms.

A former doctor's surgery in need of TLC is converted into a family home in Houghton-le-Spring. Also, a flat in a 1930s block of flats in Edgware and a detached house in a woodland garden in Ashford in Kent are also given makeovers.

Three developers have very different reasons for making their investments: there's a family home in Consett in County Durham, a rental investment in Derby and an auction buy in Beckenham in London which will be used to run a new business, which the owner hopes will give him more time with his family.

Dion looks round a large Victorian terrace in Plumstead, Martin is in Mickleover in Derby hearing a father and daughter's plans for a flat and Lucy discovers what happened to a plot of land she saw five and a half years ago.

Martin looks round a bungalow in a stunning setting in the Lake District while Dion has a look at a flat close to Nottingham city centre. Lucy meets a woman who mistakenly thought she was buying a piece of land in Folkestone in Kent.
Lucy looks at a flat in Kilburn in London with one of the worst cases of damp she has ever seen, while Martin and Dion are in the Midlands looking round semis with potential.
A flat with huge potential in London's Earlsfield, and terraced houses in Wombourne near Wolverhampton and Ynyswen near Treorchy in Wales are all sold under the hammer.

Martin is impressed with the potential of two shops and three flats in Tonypandy in Wales while Dion looks round a two-bedroom maisonette in Dawley and Lucy meets a first-time developer with ambitious plans for an end terrace in London's Forest Gate.
A first-floor one-bedroom flat in London's Stepney Green, a three-bed semi in Dartford in Kent and a one-bedroom flat on the 17th floor of a block in Salford are all sold under the hammer.

A 1930s bungalow in Dereham in Norfolk, a first-floor flat in London's East Ham and a property in Maryport in Cumbria with a hidden room are all sold at auction. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners and hear their plans for their investments.

For two of the properties sold under the hammer, a semi in Ilkeston in Derby and a flat in Streatham Hill in London, it's all about creating smart kitchens and bathrooms. Meanwhile, the owners of a bungalow have to deal with an unexpected issue.

A fifth-floor flat in Greater Manchester, a three-bed semi in Carlisle and three commercial buildings near Stansted are all sold under the hammer. One developer has a pressing deadline to finish his renovation work.

An old Derbyshire farmhouse in Wirksworth gets a stunning makeover, a developer builds a pair of semis in Chatham in Kent, while a mid-terraced house in Blackhall Colliery in County Durham is given a makeover ready for the rental market.

Martin, Lucy and Dion meet father-and-daughter developers. An apartment in a former mill in Mow Cop on the Staffordshire and Cheshire border, a three-bed semi in East Ham and a flat in Bournemouth are all given makeovers with the help of dad.

A couple about to get married buy their first home in Newcastle, a new dad thinks developing a flat in Leyton in London will give him more time with his four-month-old son, and a former IT worker develops a property in Gainsborough in Lincolnshire.
A flat over two floors in London's Camberwell, another flat in Telford in Shropshire and a three-bed semi in Alvaston in Derby are all sold under the hammer.
Martin, Lucy and Dion visit a grand five-bedroom period house in Folkestone in Kent, a two-bedroom flat in London's Leytonstone and a two-bedroom mid-terrace in Fenton in Stoke-on-Trent.

Angela Taylor hated her estranged husband Bill because he would not grant her a divorce, so she and her lover take matters into their own hands.

Examining the terrible murder of grandma and landlady Antonietta Guarino. She was killed by her tenant in Trowbridge, Wiltshire in 2009.
Documentary examining the tragic murder of Tati Rodgers. Killed and buried by her Polish lover in Wrexham in 2008, it was 14 months before her body was discovered.
A look at the murder of 21-year-old Shaun Rossington who was fatally attacked in Lincoln in 2010. Five people were convicted of his murder.

The tragic story of Rachel Moran, who went missing on New Year's Day, 2004, sparking a mass police search in Hull which would eventually lead to her brutal killer.
Twenty-one-year-old Jane was blindfolded, driven to a caravan in Suffolk and raped. Unable to fully see, some tiny details that she recalled helped police to catch her attacker.
When a young mother vanished in Hertfordshire, police suspected she'd run off with a lover. When they eventually found her body, they had only one suspect in mind.
In 2000, the grisly remains of a man were found in Sheffield and, with just a clay mould of his decomposed face, police uncovered a chilling tale of deathly greed.
Durham couple George and Christina Button lived a happy life, but Christina was secretly mounting up debts. Was murder the only way to pay them off?
In 1989, 51 lives were lost when the pleasure boat Marchioness collided with dredger Bowbelle and sank.
Arguably Britain's most infamous serial killer, Peter Sutcliffe became known as The Yorkshire Ripper when he began murdering women in Yorkshire during the 1970s.
An inside look at the series of mysterious deaths that occurred at the Stepping Hill Hospital in Stockport, Greater Manchester, in 2011.
A look at the murder of 18-year-old Sally Anne Bowman, who was stabbed in Croydon in 2005. With interviews with Bowman's family and detectives who solved the case.
A hard-hitting look at the shocking murder of Rachel Nickell, who was sexually assaulted and stabbed to death in front of her young son on 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon Common in 1992.

Also, Paige realises that she spent too much time in the magic world.

Hoping to lure the Charmed Ones out of hiding, Haas, a young demon wanting to take over the Underworld, uses the 'Alice in Wonderland' fairy tale to prey on young victims. When Billie stumbles upon his plan and tries to stop him, she becomes one of his victims. The sisters decide to come to Billie's rescue. Also, Phoebe tries to get to know Dex better under her new identity.
Sisters battle over the repossession of a vehicle. A young man says he was assaulted after a night of heavy drinking.
A teen's roommate accuses her of stealing his laptop and vandalising their apartment. A boy denies breaking his former girlfriend's brand-new media player.
Charlie is struggling to accept Shannon's pregnancy, while Megan can't get herself to step away from Dylan. Ste stays over at Amber's and Chloe and Jordan make a tearful breakthrough.

The tattoo artists are on hand to bring the love back to disheartened Jodene, who wants to move forward from her broken relationship boob. Deal or No Deal fan Angie hits the jackpot as Jay gives her a homage to her one true love.

Bella Swan is on the cusp of her 18th birthday and blissfully happy with her undead beau Edward Cullen. While celebrating her birthday with Edward's family of 'vegetarian' vampires, a frightening incident convinces Edward that he's simply too dangerous to be around his sweetheart. He decides to leave the town of Forks in order to ensure her safety - leaving her behind, angry and depressed.
The search for Slumach's gold sends the team 300 kilometres away into the heart of mystery and murder; back in Pitt Lake, an unlikely prospector arrives with a shocking claim.
pr.sub: The Troubling Tale of Bute Inlet Gold

pr.d: A forensic technician is horrified to discover the dead have followed him home from the morgue. A caretaker develops an unhealthy obsession with an abandoned hospital after a terrifying brush with the paranormal.
Staff and patients recount when a figure follows a doctor home, a patient is tormented by evil entities and a Swami healer frees a woman from paranormal activity.
pr.sub: They Have No Eyes, Dark Things and Celebration of Death

pr.d: Mars, humanity's space frontier, once resembled Earth, and its barren landscape and newly found doorways raise existential questions.
A look at the physics of time travel and the possibility of UAPs being humans from the future.

Several UFOs suddenly appear above Swedish power plants and other places. Some believe that the country will soon be the target of an attack. A soldier claims to have encountered a UFO years ago and receives compensation from the US military.

A fleet of UFOs is filmed over the South China Sea, a 12,000-year-old archaeological site reveals carvings of alien, six-fingered humanoids, and a recorded confession claims that Albert Einstein made a secret visit to Roswell in 1947 to see a crashed UFO and its dead and dying occupants.

When a sinister cave is discovered in a remote corner of Iceland, experts uncover a secret underworld tunnelling to unknown depths, and using cutting-edge tech, they investigate if this strange place could hold secrets of alien worlds.
In the court of public opinion, the most credible UFO witnesses come from law enforcement.

Some believe a UFO was shot down by the RAF above South Wales on the 26th of February 2016. Craig and Sarah Cruddas examine the evidence as they try to discover if it really was an extra-terrestrial event, and if there's been a top level cover up.

Craig and Sarah have a closer look at a case that took place in November 2018 off the west coast of Ireland, in which pilots saw bizarre lights through their cockpit windows. The interaction with air traffic control provides the evidence.

Triangle shaped hovering objects were seen by thousands of people and investigated by scientists and government officials, yet they could never be explained. The sightings occurred in a more than two year "wave" over Belgium, beginning in late 1989.
In 1973, Calvin Parker claimed he was abducted by aliens in Mississippi. Revisit his chilling story with new evidence and expert analysis.

The US military is investigating whether conflicts could be fought through mind control and a boy who lost his thumb in a horrific accident uses a mysterious powder to regrow it.
pr.sub: The Hobbit, Limb Generation, Mind Over Matter

pr.d: A man changes personalities after a heart transplant and perfect circles of ice are formed. A mother is unrelated to her biological children.
A ghost ship is found on a remote island, home to one of Earth's last uncontacted tribes. New evidence reveals a mysterious military compound in Russia.

When a strange, red plane is discovered near the sight of the Roswell UFO incident, experts wonder if the aircraft has Nazi or extraterrestrial origins, and their investigation reveals new secrets about one of America's most famous faces.

Space Shuttle cameras record UFO footage that many experts find almost impossible to explain.
Exploring the possibility of alien involvement in the creation of enduring structures on Earth.
Ex-U.S. Intelligence officer Grusch tells the Oversight Committee about an alien craft in U.S. secret facilities.
A man in Missouri films what looks like a metal cube spinning in the sky. Something very similar is seen in LA, Texas and Columbia.
A mysterious opening on the Red Planet caught on camera, a UFO appears to invade an Amazon village, and an unidentified spacecraft disrupts the queen's jubilee celebrations in London in June 2022.
A lavish cruise ship for the super-wealthy, the Empress of Britain was called up for war duty and entered an epic final battle with the German Luftwaffe before being torpedoed by a U-boat.

The pride of France after saving many lives and surviving the Second World War, the groundbreaking luxury liner Île de France was ultimately used and flooded for a 1959 disaster film just before the ship was due to be scrapped.
A man predicts a deadly plane crash before it happens; a child has a premonition of a volcanic eruption; a California man foretells major U.S. events.
Three men disappear from a yacht in Australia; people vanish from a remote Vermont mountaintop; a pilot is stalked by unidentified aircraft.
A new report is made every 55 hours in Washington state, which is America's highest rate of UFO sightings per capita - but why are UFOs choosing to hover here?
From midair abductions to near-disasters caused by unseen enemies, experts examine if we are alone in the skies over Earth.
Alien abductees reveal details about the insides of UFOs and help researchers understand how aliens live and what they want from the human race.

Look inside the lost tomb of King Thutmose II and get new clues about Egypt's pharaohs, then dust off stone hunting structures in Saudi Arabia. Visit a 1,200-year-old mosque buried in the Negev Desert and inspect a 30-million-year-old predator skull.
pr.sub: King Thutmose II Tomb & Secret Saudi Gates

pr.d: On February 25, 1942, the skies over the sprawling city of Los Angeles erupt like a volcano. Anti-aircraft weapons fire wildly at strange targets.
Strange black holes appear near Egypt's pyramids, ruins in Peru suggest the Incas knew more than expected, and a mysterious red swarm invades a beach in India.
A ghost ship with links to the mob suddenly appears on a California beach. Plus, a lake believed to have magical healing powers holds clues to life on Mars.
Historian Dan Jones is in the heart of Snowdonia exploring a stronghold built not only as an impenetrable fortress but also as a lavish royal palace fit for a fairytale - Caernarfon Castle.
Kevin dives into the blue waters of the Caribbean to find the relics that litter the sea floor from piracy's heyday in the region.
pr.sub: The True Story of the Pirates of the Caribbean

pr.d: No matter when or where the conflict, truth often becomes the first casualty of war. John A Kantara looks at how war propaganda has used a variety of tools to spread particular narratives, including paintings, television, and social media.
A look at how religion has served as a reliable tool to brandish political power over thousands of years and been the catalyst for war, conflict, and persecution, from the Crusades to witch hunts.
Annually, Illinois gets more than 300 UFO reports, so why are the Tinley Park sightings - with over 70 witnesses each year - the only reports that happen en masse?
A fascinating look at the mounting evidence that suggests UFO waves are able to penetrate the world's most closely guarded airspace at will.
Aliens may be interested in experimenting on the human mind and body, and the human civilisation may be aliens' prized experiment.

Inside the dreaded 'Alaskan Triangle' the location of over 20,000 disappearances over the past 50 years, 4 residents of Yakutat, Alaska have an encounter that they won't soon forget when they get up close and personal with the unexplained in December 2019. The exoplanet LHS 1140 b is used to base our experts' theories as to who these visitors may be and what their POV may be like.
During the Cold War, sinister objects were seen flying above secret military bases. Were aliens monitoring the world's nuclear arsenal?
Legends of ancient giants surround a mysterious monument in the Holy Land. Plus, when a boy disappears, satellite images help with the investigation.

Am Flughafen von Honolulu sorgt eine japanische Reisende für Aufsehen: Verdächtige Herkunft und außerdem unklare Geldflüsse. Ist sie wirklich nur Urlauberin? In San Francisco suchen Zollbeamte derweil nach einem Drogenkoffer.

Eine Pistole in einem fehlgeleiteten Koffer aus London sorgt am San Francisco International Airport für Klärungsbedarf. Am selben Flughafen prüfen Beamte, ob ein allein reisender chinesischer Teenager Opfer von Menschenhandel ist. Die Lügengeschichte zweier Reisender führt die Beamten am Newark International Airport zunächst auf eine falsche Fährte.

Am 24. März 2015 befindet sich die Maschine des Germanwings-Flugs 9525 auf dem Weg von Barcelona nach Düsseldorf. Urplötzlich verliert der Airbus A320-211 über den Alpen innerhalb kürzester Zeit an Höhe. Sofort leitet die französische Flugsicherung Notfallmaßnahmen ein und versucht, den Piloten zu erreichen. Vergeblich: Der Jet verschwindet vom Radar. Erst Stunden später werden in einer unzugänglichen Bergregion Wrackteile und die Überreste von 150 Menschen entdeckt.

Frühmorgens in Kentucky: unmittelbar nach dem Start stürzt Comair-Flug 5191 ab, kaum einen Kilometer von der Piste entfernt - 49 Menschen sterben. Ermittler stellen fest, dass die Maschine von der falschen Startbahn abhob. Das wird untersucht.

Im Jahr 2018 stürzt eine erst zwei Monate alte Boeing 737 Max 8 über der Javasee ab. Alle Insassen kommen dabei ums Leben. Nach der Auswertung des Stimmrekorders wird klar, dass ein Steuerungsproblem zu der Katastrophe führte.

Eine geheime Mission in der Wüste, ein legendärer Nazi-General und eine unterirdische Festung: In Tunesien gelingt es den Alliierten 1943, Rommels unüberwindbare Mareth-Linie zu umgehen - dank der Long Range Desert Group, einer Truppe von Abenteurern mit Wüsten-Know-how. Außerdem: Ein Prachtbau in Beirut wird zum Symbol einer Katastrophe. Ein Ballsaal in Alabama, der einst das Herz der schwarzen Bürgerrechtsbewegung war. Und: Griechenlands Elite-Schule mit Eton-Ambitionen und Alcatraz-Flair.

Fort Amador in Panama-Stadt ist lange Zeit eine beschauliche Wohnsiedlung für US-Armeeangehörige in der Kanalzone - bis CIA-Machenschaften, Drogenkartelle und ein wildgewordener Diktator das tropische Idyll in eine Kampfzone verwandeln.

Peppa eagerly awaits her new sibling, growing impatient with the lengthy wait. Suddenly, Mummy Pig announces that the baby is coming right now.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.

George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.
Snooty King and Queen Marigold invite themselves round for dinner to King and Queen Thistle's Castle to sample Nanny Plum's cooking. Nanny tries very hard to cook special modern food.
Things are going missing all over the Little Kingdom - Holly has lost her wand and Ben has lost his horn! Soon they realise that ants are stealing their things.

Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to school on their scooters. When he decides that it would be quicker to ride back, he discovers that riding scooters is great fun. Mummy Pig thinks that they are fun too and they both ride the scooters.
Madame Gazelle gets Peppa and her playgroup friends to dance to all different styles of music.
Madame Gazelle takes the class to London for the day, where they are given a tour of the city by none other than the Queen of England.
Daddy Pig and Mr Bull are digging up the playground, so Daddy Pig decides to teach the kids some simple science. The first experiment is to see how many children it takes to pick up Madame Gazelle.

When a storm cancels Peppa and her family's outdoor adventure plans, they decide to bring the fun indoors. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and enjoy a campfire in the attic.
Peppa and George play in their pool, helping garden animals cool off. When rain arrives, both the animals and Peppa are pleased. The rainfall forms muddy puddles, which Peppa loves for jumping.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden, where Granny's friends are playing folk music. After they perform for Grandpa Pig, he treats everyone to freshly made apple juice.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised that there are extra rules which she does not have in her own house. On the drive home, Peppa explains to Mummy Pig that different houses have different rules.
It is a special day because Mummy and Daddy Pig have big news to tell Peppa and George, but they struggle to wait!
Nia leads the gang in planning the annual Fall Farmer's Market but, when no one shows up, she has to learn to adapt and figure out a new way for everyone to enjoy the special event.

It's Earth Day and Paddington has the important job of planting a tree. He has to find the perfect spot before it is too late. Baaz holds a spring harvest festival and everyone enjoys bringing their own celebration along.
