Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They meet Mr Bull who is using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.
pr.sub: Mr Bull Digs Up the River

pr.d: Peppa receives an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party, but a double-decker party bus arrives; the bus goes to the playground and even the beach, hosting the best party ever.
Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus; this is a job for Grampy Rabbit.
Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Café. Candy shows Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.
Peppa's Playgroup has a garden outside. The children are all having fun growing different plants and playing hide and seek in the wild wood.
Peppa and her friends visit Mrs Badger's petting farm, where they enjoy feeding the chickens and meeting cute guinea pigs.

The Carnival has come to town, and it's a chance to see all sorts of exciting things! There is Mr. Bull's Jazz Band, Miss Rabbit as the Carnival Queen and even a very special appearance from Mr. Potato.
The youngsters visit the zoo where they are shown around by zookeepers Mr Lion, Mrs Crocodile and Mr Giraffe.
Blossom helps a lost bee in the forest, and it follows her everywhere. Dimwitty and Begonia bring Papa Smurf a birthday present, but he doesn't like it and pretends to lose it.
pr.sub: Bee my Friend / Papa's Birthday Gift

pr.d: The PAW Patrol must rescue Mr. Porter and reunite an ostrich family before the big birds get into big trouble; During Mayor Goodway's fashion show, the pups must save Farmer Al and Mayor Humdinger after Humdinger's puffy shirt floats away with them.
pr.sub: Pups Save Alex's Feathery Friends / Pups Save a Fashion Show

pr.d: Mayor Goodway and Farmer Al are ready for a day filled with skydiving fun; Alex and the Mini Patrol get locked inside the flounder.
pr.sub: Pups Save the Skydivers; Pups Save the Cupcakes

pr.d: Stan claims to have a real Marsupilami appearing in a show he's putting on, but it's a fake robot. Acu thinks a fish-loving alien is in town, and Mica offers to help him track it down.
pr.sub: Stan's showtime / The Truth is Out There

pr.d: The children have adopted a new pet, a dragon named Dave. They did not know that he was going to grow and grow though and need to find him a place where he belongs.
Ben and Holly set out in the elves' new vessel to try and rescue Redbeard the elf pirate's sunken treasure. However, hungry Big Bad Barry is determined to stop them.
Holly forgets Ben's birthday and rushes home to make him a birthday card, but Nanny has stopped all magic, so Holly has to make the card herself.
Holly invites Ben to the annual Royal Fairy Picnic. King Thistle hopes there won't be a repeat of last year's magical jelly flood.
Tim, Tommy, and Tia take on their parents at Tailball.
Tim, Tommy and Tia together get lost at a play centre.
When Terri and Tommy get locked in the Garden Dome, they must put their differences aside and try to escape.
Grumblestunk is getting competitive during 'Porthole In Bloom', but so are the local robins! Why are the red-chested birds turning on each other?
pr.sub: The Good, the Bird and the Ugly

pr.d: Stan finds a treasure map in a bottle on the beach. Could it really lead to finding the lost treasure of dread pirate Abby Bird?
When Dr Talon almost makes a mistake, the trainees go to any length to prevent it, except telling her.
Peppa and George check out Grandpa's new Bug Hotel as lots of insects arrive. A bumblebee cannot find a place in the hotel because the rooms are too small for him.
Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy!
Peppa and her friends have fun while painting in the playgroup. Madame Gazelle then teaches them how to play games with parachutes.
Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they [LIVE], play and build whatever the community needs.
pr.sub: The Crew Fixes A Blocked Pipe/The Crew Builds A Construction Basketball Show

pr.d: At the Farm Fair, a mysterious critter chews up everything in sight, and the pups must save the day! Later, Rocky dreams a sudsy accident turns Adventure Bay into a giant bubble bath, putting everyone at risk!
pr.sub: Pups Save the Farm Festival; Pups and the Bubble Bath Bay!

pr.d: Digi & Tal are visiting Dino Island to help Rex with dinosaur safety. When they take safety too far, they accidentally put the island at risk. When Daring Danny X's epic dino-stunt goes awry, he winds up with a grouchy Spinosaurus.
pr.sub: Pups Save a Dino Digi and Tal; Pups Save a Dino Daredevil

pr.d: CatRat wants to plan a party for Gabby's birthday, but Gabby can't decide on a theme.
Mandy Mouse joins Peppa's playgroup. She uses a wheelchair and is super sporty. The children have a lot of fun playing together.

Mummy Pig's book is finished, and it's time to show it off to Peppa and her playgroup friends. Unfortunately, Peppa and George lose some of the book when they are playing, and Mummy Pig has to think quickly to fix it.
George has lost Mr Dinosaur. Mummy suggests they go to the police station to see if someone has handed him in.
A new student, Gerald the giraffe, joins the playgroup where Peppa and her friends go. However, when he tries to fit in, he finds it difficult to play hide-and-seek because he is so tall.
The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard. The children all believe it's a dinosaur. Mr Lion says if he did have a dinosaur, he would keep that a secret.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden, where Granny's friends are playing folk music. After they perform for Grandpa Pig, he treats everyone to freshly made apple juice.
King Thistle wants fish for dinner, so he goes out fishing with Mr Elf, Ben and Holly on Mr Elf's boat. Mr Elf tells them a story about the biggest, worst fish ever, Big Bad Barry.
Queen Thistle has a beautiful new teapot that is so delicate that no one is allowed to touch it. Holly accidentally breaks the Queen Thistle's teapot and tries to fix it with Ben's help.

Sir Topham Hatt places a plaque at the top of Lookout Mountain so that tourists can take in all of Sodor in just one sight; when the efficient tour falls flat, Thomas takes visitors to really see Sodor.
When Thomas meets some buzz-worthy newcomers who need help finding a home, the tank engine and his friends come to the rescue.
Grumblestunk is getting competitive during 'Porthole In Bloom', but so are the local robins! Why are the red-chested birds turning on each other?
pr.sub: The Good, the Bird and the Ugly

pr.d: Stan finds a treasure map in a bottle on the beach. Could it really lead to finding the lost treasure of dread pirate Abby Bird?
Tim makes an attempt at creating his very own Captain DinoStar movie.
It's the Roar festival, and Tim wants to have the best Roar in town.
Tim fakes it to prove he's just as cool as Kai's cousin.

The Browns meet Shantee the lighthouse keeper when they arrive at the beach for their holiday. Paddington, Jonathan, and Judy become trainee lifeguards and end up rescuing Mr Brown with Taylor the lifeguard's help.
pr.sub: Paddington's Summer Holiday Begins; Paddington's Life Guard Training

pr.d: Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party and the children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They are kitted out in safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning to play.
Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques: brushes, sponges, buggy ropes and even a paint cannon!
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first?

At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr. Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and even how to throw punches in the right stance. Mr. Bull gives them their white belts.

Dr Hamster has brought a giant ant farm and opens the ant farm's lid to show how they got in. Nobody noticed they escaped and starting moving things in the classroom! The children place food around to lead the ants safely back.
Grampy Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tour of an exercise park. Since the machines are only for grownups, the kids do funny exercises instead.
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!
After finding out Daddy Pig has a place in the London Marathon, Peppa and George help Daddy Pig become stronger with lots of different, though not all typical, exercises.
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy!
Mr Elf has built a new boat to replace the one Big Bad Barry ate. He is nervous when the king commands him to take them on a cruise to a tropical paradise.
Ben, Holly and Gaston the Ladybird find a large egg in the meadow. A tiny chick hatches from the egg and the children must find the mummy bird.
Peppa and George play with walkie-talkies at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandpa Pig teaches Peppa and George how to use codenames to talk using the gadgets.
Mummy Pig dresses as a firefighter to practise fighting fires at the fire station with the other mummies. The fire brigade demonstrates how to do so effectively using their motto, Ready, Steady, Go.
For World Book Day, the playgroup must dress up as a character from their favourite book. But Peppa can't decide which as she has so many favourites.

When a storm cancels Peppa and her family's outdoor adventure plans, they decide to bring the fun indoors. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and enjoy a campfire in the attic.
At Chloe's birthday party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the inflatable obstacle course to reach the prize.
Peppa and her friends, accompanied by Mummy Sheep and Granny Sheep, take Vanessa to Grampy Rabbit's boatyard for inspiration. The children create various artworks using items found around the yard.

Peppa and her friends head to the trampoline park where Miss Rabbit shows them how to bounce. As Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Mummy Sheep watch the children play, they decide they want to have a go at trampolining.
Peppa and George learn some wonderful magic words. Nice things happen when they say please and thank you.

While Peppa and her friends are at playgroup, Madame Gazelle tells them about a lucky hamper of goodies they are going to make and place in a charity raffle. The project is a huge success, as the children gather fruit from their homes.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden, where Granny's friends are playing folk music. After they perform for Grandpa Pig, he treats everyone to freshly made apple juice.
Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in a flat above the shops. Peggy and Pandora Panda and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.

At the playground, Pedro and Penny's glasses fall off; both think that their glasses are broken, as they cannot see very well; Madame Gazelle shows Pedro and Penny different types of objects with lenses.
Peppa looks after Madame Gazelle's guinea pigs Ginger and Brian while she goes on holiday, but they prove to be more trouble for Mummy and Daddy Pig than they think.
Peppa and her friends are in a playgroup and Mr Bull is building a wind turbine. Madame Gazelle explains everything to the children about wind energy.
Mummy Pig suggests the family all make pizzas together, so everyone prepares and chooses the food to make their own individual pizzas.
Peppa and her family hire a canoe from Miss Rabbit. They imagine they are in a jungle and then unexpectedly bump into Mrs Crocodile. Later on, Mr Lion invites them to have a picnic.
There's a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama. She can speak a foreign language, and Peppa loves talking. Everyone loves talking.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Peppa, her friends, and their parents, learn woodworking from Mister Wolf. He asks Daddy Pig to make a hut out of twigs, but it isn't very strong, and Mister Wolf manages to blow it down.
Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast.
Grampy Rabbit teaches Danny Dog and Peppa why his lifeboat is so important when it comes to saving lives at sea and gives them tips on how to stay safe.
Pedro loves superheroes. He has a superhero party and Super Potato is one of the guests. Together, they play some party games and Super Potato gets to show everyone his superpowers.
At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading the children a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own alternative endings.

Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night; before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, which popcorn to eat and take a toilet break -- then they're finally ready.
Peppa and her friends are playing in their clubhouse, which has a fold-down counter at the front. The children pretend to run a little shop for the parents to buy things from.

Peppa and her friends come to school early to have breakfast together. They learn about how food gives you energy and talk about their favourite breakfast foods. They all end up having toast with fun toppings. Finally, they have a good stretch and dance to get ready for the day and all sing the breakfast song.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel visit Peppa's playgroup. They offer two lucky children the chance to spend the day with them.
Miss Rabbit is teaching the children a swimming lesson, They start out by swimming with floats tucked under their arms.
Features the grown-up's singing competition where the kids are the judges.
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first?

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup and today Madame Gazelle would like them all to play music. They think they are playing with normal instruments, but today the children must make their own instruments. Madame Gazelle gathers bits and bobs of old packaging and shows them how to make their own. At the end of the day, they put on a special concert for the parents.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa, George and Danny Dog to visit Grampy Rabbit's lighthouse.
Daddy teaches Peppa and George a fun game to play while they wait inside for the rain to stop.
Peppa and George visit Daddy Pig's office and meet his colleagues. Mr Rabbit works with numbers, while Mrs Cat seems to spend her time drawing shapes on a computer.
Peppa and her friends go on a camping trip with their teacher, Madame Gazelle. After pitching their tents and collecting sticks, they all sing a song around the campfire.
A new student, Gerald the giraffe, joins the playgroup where Peppa and her friends go. However, when he tries to fit in, he finds it difficult to play hide-and-seek because he is so tall.
Peppa's family are at Digger World, where they have fun building walls and knocking them over again, and even help Mr Bull when there's an obstacle in the road.
George finds a very friendly spider in the bathroom. Peppa is very frightened until she realises that the little spider doesn't want to hurt her. She names him Mister Skinny legs.
Delphine the donkey comes to stay. Peppa takes Delphine to playgroup, where they teach her the 'Bing Bong Song'.
Mummy Pig gives her old computer to Granny and Grandpa Pig. They use it for lots of important work, as well as Happy Mrs Chicken, but when it breaks they are not sure who will fix it.
Peppa and her friends go to help at Edmond Elephant's birthday party, but the little children are harder to look after than they'd thought.
Peppa and George visit Granny Pig, who is very excited about her new pet, a parrot called Polly.
Peppa and George have to tidy their bedroom. After a frenzy of cleaning, the room is tidy, but the room doesn't stay tidy for long though.
Daddy Pig hangs his clean football shirt out to dry, but Peppa, George and Mummy splash it with mud. They put it in the wash, but Peppa puts her red dress in too, which turns Daddy's shirt pink.
Doctor Hamster visits the school and brings some animals with her. Binky the Tortoise is very popular, but ends up needing to be rescued by Miss Rabbit.
Peppa and her family collect apples and blackberries in Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden to make a pie.
Madame Gazelle gets Peppa and her playgroup friends to dance to all different styles of music.
Peppa and George go behind the scenes to find out how TV is made when Miss Rabbit shows them around the set of Super Potato's TV show.
Mummy and Daddy Pig show Peppa and George how to play flying discs in the park. Soon their friends appear with their parents.
Peppa celebrates Goldie's birthday by holding an undersea party - by turning the house into an underwater environment.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.

Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the skate park with their bicycles, scooters and skateboards. While Peppa has fun playing around on Daddy's skateboard, she soon learns that he is more of an expert than she realised.
Mr Labrador is here in his new ice cream van. It is his first day selling ice creams. In fact, Mr Labrador loves ice cream, perhaps a little too much.

Granny and Grandpa Pig have been growing strawberries to make jam, but the birds have eaten all the fruit. They decide to go and pick their own at Miss Rabbit's strawberry farm, but Granny and Grandpa eat too many strawberries and end up very full.
Peppa and her friends visit the Little Cars Play Centre where Miss Rabbit is in charge, and they get to drive little toy cars.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.
It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They hide in it during a snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and also Peppa's igloo.
The children learn about the weather, there is a new friend for Peppa, and Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's where Grandpa Pig is making a Rock Garden.
Mandy Mouse has a birthday visit to a cheese theme park with Peppa and her friends. Everything in the park is cheese-themed, and Mandy loves cheese.
Inspired by Granny Pig's stories of ancient Rome, Peppa and George decide to design the mosaic of a dinosaur with pebbles, and learn a little Latin.
Peppa and her family have gone on holiday, staying in a teeny tiny little holiday home near the beach. They discover that even when it rains, they can have lots of fun.
Peppa and all her friends are having a sleep-over, with different friends in each of the four different flats in the high street. They decide to play hide and seek across all the rooms.
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.
While drawing pictures at playgroup, Peppa and her friends learn about each other's families, from Suzy sheep who lives with Mummy Sheep to Freddy Fox who lives with Mr. Fox.

While Mummy Pig is at work, Peppa, George and Daddy make the best out of not being able to use the computer by tidying the kitchen, and when they find a jelly mould, they decide to make a nice surprise for their busy mum.
Grandpa and Granny Pig dust off their motorbike and sidecar to take Peppa and George on a trip. They go to the beach and camp in a tent that folds out of the sidecar.
Peppa Pig and Suzy Sheep are spending the day with Doctor Hamster, and they are learning about what vets do. Doctor Hamster says she's glad to have two helpers with her and calls the next patient.
While at a playgroup with Madame Gazelle, Peppa and her friends learn all about the weather by building themselves a Weather Station, complete with thermometer, wind turbine and rain collector.
Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day; after a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds an art piece at Suzy's house.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandma, Peppa and George go to the shed to see what Grandpa is doing and discover that he's built a robot.

Mummy and Daddy take Peppa and George for a day out at the botanical gardens. Miss Rabbit is there to greet them and show them around. There's the hot house, the cold house, the rainforest garden and the laboratory where Mr Rabbit creates new varieties of flowers. Last of all, there is the children's garden, which has another water feature... mud!
Peppa and George are playing in the garden when they hear a strange noise. It's thunder. Peppa and George are a little bit frightened at first but Peppa soon decides that she loves thunderstorms.
Peppa and her family spot a rainbow when they go for a drive.
Peppa and her family are trying to get to the playground, but Mr Bull's roadworks are in the way.

Peppa and George's toy basket is full, and their beds are covered in toys, so Mummy Pig decides it is time to order a new toy cupboard. The cupboard arrives in the post, but it needs to be assembled - and Mummy and Daddy Pig are not very good at DIY. Luckily help is at hand, as Mr Zebra the Postman loves assembling flat-pack furniture.
Granny and Grandpa's pet Polly Parrot comes to stay, and Peppa and George love Polly Parrot. But when she flies away, no one knows what to do.
Grandpa Pig has built a fantastic little train called Gertrude, and when they take a ride, they give all their friends a ride.
When Peppa goes for a sleepover at Zoe Zebra's house with Suzy Sheep, Rebecca Rabbit, Candy Cat and Emily Elephant, the girls are too excited to go to sleep.
It's nighttime at Grandpa and Granny Pig's house, and Peppa and George have stayed up late to help hunt for slugs and snails. But what other night animals will they find?
Peppa and George make everyone laugh when they dress up as Mummy and Daddy Pig.
When Daddy Pig loses his glasses he gets a bit grumpy, but Peppa and George have lots of fun looking for them.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her friends on a train ride where they must tick off what they see on their activity sheets.
Peppa and family go on a walk through the forest where they meet all of their favourite fairytale characters. They visit the home of bears who like porridge and meet a hungry Mr Wolf.
Peppa and all her friends at playgroup dress up as different countries from all over the world.
Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden when they find a little snail.
Peppa and Suzy Sheep are best friends, but one day they have a quarrel over a game of cards and decide they are not best friends any more.
When the school roof is broken and needs fixing, Peppa volunteers Mummy Pig to do a parachute jump to raise money. Daddy Pig goes up too, and has to overcome his fear of heights.

Mummy Pig's book is finished, and it's time to show it off to Peppa and her playgroup friends. Unfortunately, Peppa and George lose some of the book when they are playing, and Mummy Pig has to think quickly to fix it.
Peppa and George love going to the beach on sunny days. They bring their water wings, a beach ball and buckets and spades. Peppa and George have fun burying Daddy Pig in the sand.
Peppa and George go on a boat trip with Grandpa Pig, but they must send Polly Parrot for help when their boat runs aground. Polly fetches Granny Pig and Grandad Dog to rescue them.
Peppa and her friends and family are looking forward to a trip to the seaside where they can make sandcastles, but when they arrive at the beach there is too much snow.
Mrs Zebra teaches Peppa, George, Zoe, Zaza and Zuzu Zebra how to make a real tea set from clay.
Madame Gazelle takes the class to London for the day, where they are given a tour of the city by none other than the Queen of England.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her school friends on a school bus trip to the mountains. From the top of the mountains, there is a fantastic view, and Peppa and her friends have fun hearing echoes.
Playgroup is having a pet competition and everyone has brought their pets. Dr Hamster is the judge, but it is so hard to choose the best pet.
Peppa and her friends play some very active games in the garden.
Madame Gazelle teaches the children how to play the recorder. They practise a lot at home, then put on a performance for all the parents to enjoy.
Peppa, George and Daddy Pig visit the charity shop to sell things they don't need, and things they may need.
Peppa and George play in their grandparents' garden on a very hot day, but they don't have a paddling pool; Granny and Grandpa Pig create their own water squeezers and even a water slide.
Mum, Dad, Peppa and George decide to go to the beach on a beautiful sunny day. Suddenly, a little cloud covers the sun for a minute, but then it passes and the sun reappears.
Peppa and Suzy are excited about the sleepover and sit up in bed talking about what they will do when they grow up.
The playgroup visits a nature reserve, specialising in tiny insects, bugs, and butterflies. So Pedro brings along his pet stick insect.
Mandy Mouse joins Peppa's playgroup. She uses a wheelchair and is super sporty. The children have a lot of fun playing together.
Peppa and her family enjoy the apple tree at the top of the hill. It has a swing on it that they all like to swing on and Peppa has a special song for it.
Grampy Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tour of an exercise park. Since the machines are only for grownups, the kids do funny exercises instead.
Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival, a jigsaw festival. Peppa learns the secrets of puzzles from Grandma Donkey.

Peppa and George are watching a television show about Detective Potato and how he helps people find things. Daddy needs to buy some gravel so Peppa and George go with him. They park the car in a very large car park, but when they return, they can't remember where they parked it. Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel arrive to help Daddy Pig but have no luck. Suddenly, Detective Potato appears and saves the day.
Peppa, George and Freddy Fox are mistaken for pirates while sailing on the river with Grandpa Pig. When the truth is revealed, officers Panda and Squirrel invite them for a ride in their police boat.
During a picnic in her garden, cousin Chloe shows Peppa and George fun things to do with flowers.
Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!
After finding out Daddy Pig has a place in the London Marathon, Peppa and George help Daddy Pig become stronger with lots of different, though not all typical, exercises.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby!
Peppa eagerly awaits her new sibling, growing impatient with the lengthy wait. Suddenly, Mummy Pig announces that the baby is coming right now.
Madame Gazelle needs to go to the dentist and Bull takes over Peppa's class. As the children already know the suggested themes, Bull decides to show them how to fix a floorboard that is creaking.
Peppa and George go behind the scenes to find out how TV is made when Miss Rabbit shows them around the set of Super Potato's TV show.
Mummy and Daddy Pig show Peppa and George how to play flying discs in the park. Soon their friends appear with their parents.
Peppa celebrates Goldie's birthday by holding an undersea party - by turning the house into an underwater environment.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.

Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the skate park with their bicycles, scooters and skateboards. While Peppa has fun playing around on Daddy's skateboard, she soon learns that he is more of an expert than she realised.
Peppa and her friends are playing pirates, but when they put together a treasure chest and bury it in a marked spot, Pedro soon realises that he needs to follow the trail. He's lost something.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are going out for the evening. Granny and Grandpa Pig babysit Peppa and George. They are too excited to sleep. When Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig get home everyone is asleep.
Peppa and Luzie Locke find that adults have to work all the time. The children imitate the elders, in the shop and on the playground. They realise that playing can be really hard work.
Peppa and her friends learn how to count by playing games at Madame Gazelle's playschool.
Madame Gazelle gives the class a music lesson. There's lots of crashing and banging at first, but it's not long before the grown-ups visit and lay down some notes of their own.
George has fun making bubbles, and Peppa has fun popping them.
Suzy Sheep has come to play with Peppa, and has made up a pretend friend called 'Leo Lion'. Peppa can't see Leo, but Suzy announces that Leo likes roaring and playing dressing up.
It's Daddy Pig's birthday, but he has to go to work, so while he's away, Mummy Pig, Peppa and George prepare a special birthday surprise.
Daddy Pig is left behind when everyone takes Grampy Rabbit's little boat to the riverside picnic spot. Will someone remember him and save him some cake?
When Daddy Pig and Mummy Pig are tidying up the house, they happen to find an old box of musical instruments. George makes a loud sound with the Swiss horn.
Peppa and George love helping Mummy Pig work on her computer, but they like playing computer games more.
The youngsters visit the zoo where they are shown around by zookeepers Mr Lion, Mrs Crocodile and Mr Giraffe.
Peppa and George are helping Grandpa Pig to dig a new pond for his garden. While digging, they find hidden treasure so they go to see Mr Richard in the museum.
Dr Hamster's pet tortoise, Tiddles, once again gets stuck on top of a tree, but everyone in the rescue team finds it tough to get the tortoise down.
Peppa and her family are at the swimming pool. George is a little worried at first but is soon splashing happily with his friend Richard Rabbit.
Peppa and George are helping Granny and Grandpa Pig tidy their attic, but they have trouble deciding what to throw out because Granny and Grandpa want to keep everything.

It's a beautiful day but Peppa, George and Grandpa Pig are sitting inside watching the motor racing on the television. Granny Pig shoos them all outside to enjoy the sunshine. Inspired by the racing, Grandpa Pig builds George his own racing car.
Peppa and George visit Granny Pig, who is very excited about her new pet, a parrot called Polly.
Peppa and George have to tidy their bedroom. After a frenzy of cleaning, the room is tidy, but the room doesn't stay tidy for long though.
Daddy Pig hangs his clean football shirt out to dry, but Peppa, George and Mummy splash it with mud. They put it in the wash, but Peppa puts her red dress in too, which turns Daddy's shirt pink.
Doctor Hamster visits the school and brings some animals with her. Binky the Tortoise is very popular, but ends up needing to be rescued by Miss Rabbit.
Peppa and her family collect apples and blackberries in Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden to make a pie.
Madame Gazelle gets Peppa and her playgroup friends to dance to all different styles of music.
The grass has grown so long that Peppa and George's ball gets lost in it. It falls to Grandpa to save the day with Betsy, his motorised lawnmower.
Mr Labrador is here in his new ice cream van. It is his first day selling ice creams. In fact, Mr Labrador loves ice cream, perhaps a little too much.

Granny and Grandpa Pig have been growing strawberries to make jam, but the birds have eaten all the fruit. They decide to go and pick their own at Miss Rabbit's strawberry farm, but Granny and Grandpa eat too many strawberries and end up very full.
Peppa and her friends visit the Little Cars Play Centre where Miss Rabbit is in charge, and they get to drive little toy cars.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.
It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They hide in it during a snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and also Peppa's igloo.
The children learn about the weather, there is a new friend for Peppa, and Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's where Grandpa Pig is making a Rock Garden.
Mandy Mouse has a birthday visit to a cheese theme park with Peppa and her friends. Everything in the park is cheese-themed, and Mandy loves cheese.
Inspired by Granny Pig's stories of ancient Rome, Peppa and George decide to design the mosaic of a dinosaur with pebbles, and learn a little Latin.
Peppa and her family have gone on holiday, staying in a teeny tiny little holiday home near the beach. They discover that even when it rains, they can have lots of fun.
Peppa and all her friends are having a sleep-over, with different friends in each of the four different flats in the high street. They decide to play hide and seek across all the rooms.
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.
While drawing pictures at playgroup, Peppa and her friends learn about each other's families, from Suzy sheep who lives with Mummy Sheep to Freddy Fox who lives with Mr. Fox.

While Mummy Pig is at work, Peppa, George and Daddy make the best out of not being able to use the computer by tidying the kitchen, and when they find a jelly mould, they decide to make a nice surprise for their busy mum.
Grandpa and Granny Pig dust off their motorbike and sidecar to take Peppa and George on a trip. They go to the beach and camp in a tent that folds out of the sidecar.
Peppa Pig and Suzy Sheep are spending the day with Doctor Hamster, and they are learning about what vets do. Doctor Hamster says she's glad to have two helpers with her and calls the next patient.
While at a playgroup with Madame Gazelle, Peppa and her friends learn all about the weather by building themselves a Weather Station, complete with thermometer, wind turbine and rain collector.
Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day; after a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds an art piece at Suzy's house.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandma, Peppa and George go to the shed to see what Grandpa is doing and discover that he's built a robot.

Mummy and Daddy take Peppa and George for a day out at the botanical gardens. Miss Rabbit is there to greet them and show them around. There's the hot house, the cold house, the rainforest garden and the laboratory where Mr Rabbit creates new varieties of flowers. Last of all, there is the children's garden, which has another water feature... mud!
Peppa and her friends play some very active games in the garden.
Madame Gazelle teaches the children how to play the recorder. They practise a lot at home, then put on a performance for all the parents to enjoy.
Peppa, George and Daddy Pig visit the charity shop to sell things they don't need, and things they may need.
Peppa and George play in their grandparents' garden on a very hot day, but they don't have a paddling pool; Granny and Grandpa Pig create their own water squeezers and even a water slide.
Mum, Dad, Peppa and George decide to go to the beach on a beautiful sunny day. Suddenly, a little cloud covers the sun for a minute, but then it passes and the sun reappears.
George pays a visit to Mr Fox's Shop after his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur, breaks. With all the additional features, surely Dino Roar is a good replacement?
It's fruit day at the market and Miss Rabbit is making smoothies from people's favourite fruit. She gives George a special 'dinosaur' juice to make him big and strong.
Peppa and George have fun in the snow, as they make footprints, snowballs and build a snowman.
Mummy Pig has a lovely new picture of Peppa and George, so Daddy Pig offers to put it up, but it's not as simple as Daddy Pig thought, and he makes a very big hole in the wall.
Goldie the fish does not look happy and is not eating her food. Peppa, George, and Mummy Pig take her on a bus trip to visit Dr Hamster the vet.

Peppa has a new pen pal, a little donkey from France named Delphine. Peppa receives letters from Delphine Donkey and speaks to her on the telephone. Although Peppa speaks English and Delphine speaks French, they discover that they love lots of the same things, especially jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
Granny Pig is really pleased with all the plastic gnomes and wishing well she's got for the garden. Peppa and George love them too, but Grandpa Pig wishes they would all disappear.
Mummy Dog surprises Captain Daddy Dog with a gift of a boat trip for his birthday, but when Peppa and the gang come along, the trip doesn't go to plan.

Mummy and Daddy Pig let Peppa and George put their coats on over their pyjamas and go outside to look at the stars. With the help of a telescope, Daddy Pig teaches Peppa and George how to find the North Star.

When a fishing trip goes wrong, leaving Grandpa Pig and Grampy Rabbit stranded on a desert island, Captain Daddy Dog is the only one able to save them. It makes him realise that he misses the sea after all.
Peppa loves secrets, so Mummy Pig makes her a special box to put secret things in.

Peppa's best friend, Suzy Sheep, comes to play at Peppa's house for the afternoon. Peppa won't allow George to join in. When Peppa and Suzy want to play doctors and nurses, George is delighted to be the patient.
Granny and Grandpa Pig come for a dinner party with Mummy and Daddy Pig. Peppa and George are too tired to go to bed until they are told a story.
Daddy Pig winds up the old cuckoo clock in Peppa and George's bedroom. When the clock strikes the hour, a wooden bird pops out, flapping its wings and singing 'Cuckoo'.
Daddy teaches the children how to play basketball, and it is not long before they are good enough to take on a much bigger team.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to play in the playground. On the way it starts to get foggy, and before long it becomes so foggy that they can't see anything.

The Detective introduces his new friend, the superhero Super Potato, who teaches children the importance of eating fruit and vegetables every day, and later helps the Detective out of a complicated situation.
Peppa and the Pig family attend a school fête. Peppa's favourite things at the fête are face painting, the balloons, and the bouncy castle.
Everyone in Peppa's town is excited to meet Mr Potato when he comes to open a new sports centre.
Peppa and George want to jump in muddy puddles, but Mummy tells them to go in the pool instead.
Peppa and George take a bin of vegetable peelings to Grandpa Pig's compost heap. Worms inside the bin turn the peelings into compost, which Granny and Grandpa use to help their plants grow.
Madame Gazelle sets the children a creative task of making masks. There are carrot masks, robot masks, and even pretty butterfly masks. The only thing missing is lots and lots of glitter.
Madame Gazelle takes the children to Grampy Rabbit's gym class, where they learn how to be real explorers.
Grandpa Pig is planting seeds to make a flower garden, but the birds keep eating them, so Peppa and George help Grandpa Pig to make a scarecrow, which stops the birds eating Grandpa's seeds.

Plankton hat es wieder einmal auf Mr. Krabs und SpongeBob abgesehen, doch Perla entdeckt, dass Plankton Angst vor Walen hat und rettet die beiden. Gary verliebt sich im Schneckenpark in Mary, doch diese hat einen zornigen Freund.

Halmoni falls in love with a customer's dog, and rather than return him, she dog-naps him and goes on the lam. Jack volunteers to run the Groom and Board solo, but when a pet snake causes chaos he must protect the other pets from the jaws of death.

Thaddäus will in der Krossen Krabbe sein Theaterstück aufführen, muss dabei aber weiterarbeiten. SpongeBob macht sich währenddessen Sorgen um Sandy, die in Texas ihren Rodeo-Meistertitel verteidigt und startet eine Rettungsaktion.
pr.sub: Mit dem Essen spielt man nicht; Rodeo in Texas

pr.d: In an attempt to get out of the dentist, Lily insists on a summer celebration of the fall holiday Chuseok. When Will accidentally befriends an annoying man, his sorry attempts at a break-up make things painfully awkward for the whole family.
pr.sub: Summer Chuseok; Putting up With the Plovers

pr.d: Plankton gibt sich als SpongeBobs Uroma aus, um an das Rezept für Krabbenburger zu kommen. Gary zieht Münzen magnetisch an und wird deswegen von Mr. Krabs für einen Raubzug missbraucht, den beiden steht großes Unheil bevor.
pr.sub: Besuch von Omama; Für eine Handvoll Kleingeld

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: While Boss Baby is away, interim manager Staci must fend off three challenges -- from Pyg & Tam, OCB and Bug the Pug.

Patrick trifft ein Monster und freundet sich mit ihm an. Natürlich lernt auch SpongeBob das Monster kennen und findet es ebenfalls super, allerdings ist es tollpatschig, was die Bürger der Stadt verärgert. Bikini Bottom gerät in ein Bermuda-Dreieck.
pr.sub: Legenden aus Bikini Bottom - Monsterbesuch in Bikini Bottom; Legenden aus Bikini Bottom - Willkommen im Bikini-Bottom-Dreieck

pr.d: The key to reassembling the Paradox Prism lies in one of the Shatterspaces. But Nine and Sonic must find a portal to safely transport the Shards there.

Mr. Krabs handelt sich durch seine geizige Art einen Fluch einer alten Dame ein und SpongeBob und Mr. Krabs müssen dies nun rückgängig machen. Sponge und Patrick suchen nach dem Haupt-Ablassstopfen, durch den das Wasser des Meeres abgelassen wird.
pr.sub: Der Fluch des Banns; Kein Meer mehr

pr.d: The Z-Force gives Max and Phoebe a superhero day off. However, when they start reliving the day over and over again, they must find a way to break the loop.

SpongeBob und Patrick finden sich nach einem Absturz bei den tiefsten Hinterdeichlern wieder und versuchen, sich zu arrangieren. Obwohl es ihm wehtut, muss Thaddäus wegen eines ausbrechenden Vulkans, SpongeBob wieder um Hilfe bitten.
Determined to meet a famous pop singer visiting Hiddenville High, Phoebe and Max devise elaborate schemes to insert themselves into her performance that quickly lead to disastrous results.

SpongeBob muss sich auf die weite Reise zum Geheimversteck der Geheimformel machen, weil in der Krossen Krabbe die Krabben Burger ausgehen. Er muss dafür mit dem Ozeanien-Express fahren, doch er ist nicht allein auf seiner Reise.
A dangerous criminal who just escaped from Swellview prison, embarrasses Kid Danger and traps Captain Man in a helmet. Kid Danger must use the help of Schwoz to gain a superpower and defeat Drex.

Patrick und SpongeBob legen ein Tunnelsystem unter Bikini Bottom an, weil sie nicht mehr auf das Grundstück von Thaddäus dürfen. Patrick entpuppt sich dabei als enormes Karatetalent, doch leider kann er sein neues Können nicht im Zaum halten.
A dangerous criminal escapes from Swellview prison, embarrasses Kid Danger and traps Captain Man in a helmet, Kid Danger must use the help of Schwoz to gain a superpower and defeat Drex.

Mr. Krabs hat eine neue Geschäftsidee und füllt eine alte Vorratsdose bei einem großen Event mit Erinnerungsstücken für die Nachwelt, dort landen auch SpongeBob und Thaddäus und werden begraben. SpongeBob und Patrick treiben Thaddäus in den Wahnsinn.
pr.sub: Nach uns die Nachwelt; Thaddäus im Tiki-Land

pr.d: The Twins and Marsupilamis want to play in the park, but Rosa is guarding the entrance so they need to find another way in. Marcel sneaks into the Chahuta and the Marsupilamis give him a fright!

Ein Kunde gibt per Telefon eine Pizzabestellung in der Krossen Krabbe ab und möchte sie nach Hause geliefert bekommen. SpongeBobs Ananas-Haus wurde aufgefressen. Nun muss er sich eine neue Unterkunft suchen, doch dies erweist sich als schwierig.

SpongeBob und Patrick planen ein Comeback der Unterwasser-Superhelden Meerjungfraumann und Blaubarsch-Bube. Die sind allerdings schon im Ruhestand, außerdem hat SpongeBob Angst, zu versagen, und traut sich nicht mehr in die Krosse Krabbe.

Thaddäus muss eine neue Fahrprüfung ablegen, Schuld daran ist natürlich SpongeBob. Und dann kommt der ihm auch bei der Prüfung in die Quere. SpongeBob soll für Mr. Krabs als Journalist arbeiten, weil der mit Schlagzeilen Geld verdienen will.
There's one dessert missing to keep with tradition! Chef and Blossom head to Gargamel's to steal it, but he's celebrating Christmas with his family.
Blossom brings Scaredy on a trip to the forest to conquer his fear. When Painter Smurf wants to throw away Baby Smurf's art, it causes a sensation in the village.

Perla will mit ihren Freundinnen eine Pyjama-Party veranstalten und wirft ihren Vater aus dem Haus. Der zieht also zu SpongeBob. SpongeBob will, dass Gary beim Schnecken-Schönheitswettbewerb gewinnt und macht ihn dafür hübsch.
Jokey wants to prove to everyone that he's capable of looking after Baby Smurf.

Lily and Farmer have to save the village from a slobbering monster. Gargamel transforms Rowena into a Smurfette in an attempt to capture Smurfs, but Mummy begins adoring her because she reminded her of her doll from her childhood.
pr.sub: Monster in the Village; Granny's Doll

pr.d: Mr. Krabs, SpongeBob, Patrick und Thaddäus werden von einer riesigen Welle erfasst. Alle werden in eine andere Ecke gespült. Mr. Krabs landet im Holländer-Dreieck, von dem man nicht so leicht fliehen kann. Er braucht die Hilfe der Freunde.
Tempers flare when the Chipmunks get stuck in traffic on the way to a show. Simon becomes annoyed by constant requests to fix things and plays dumb until he gets a thank-you.

SpongeBob hat Glück: Er findet eine wertvolle Perle, die er für viel Geld verkaufen kann. Jetzt sind alle hinter seinem Geld her. Thaddäus will beim Männergesangsverein mitmachen und muss gegen SpongeBob antreten.

When Alvin insists on taking over the drums from Theodore, Theodore fights back by stealing Alvin's persona. As Theodore is perfecting a pancake recipe, Alvin plays a trick by pouring burping powder in his next batch.

SpongeBob und Patrick sollen als Wrestler für Mr. Krabs in den Ring steigen und gewinnen. SpongeBob will unbedingt eine wertvolle und seltene Meerjungfraumann-Sammelkarte ergattern. Leider hat Patrick diese zuerst bekommen.

SpongeBob will mehr über die Wikinger herausfinden, aber keiner kann ihm so richtig helfen. Also schreibt er einen Brief an den lieben Wikinger. Patrick und SpongeBob verlassen kurz die Bootsfahrschule, um zu einer Autogrammstunde zu gehen.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: Baby love has never been higher, but a crash is coming, and the Boss Baby and his crew are determined to bring Bubbeezee down for good.

Zufällig entsteht ein Krosser Hot Dog, der bei den Kunden so gut ankommt, dass der Krabbenburger verbannt wird, weshalb SpongeBob rebelliert. SpongeBob und Patrick finden ein altes Piratenschiff, das für Mr. Krabs eine willkommene Geldquelle ist.
pr.sub: Krosse Dogs; Das Wrack der Mauna Loa

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: As the newly named CEO, the Boss Baby sets a goal for baby love to hit 100%, and everyone works overtime to please him.

Dora, Boots und Diego machen sich auf, um einen Baby-Jaguar zu retten, der sich in den Tiefen des Regenwalds verirrt hat. Dora, Boots und Diego helfen einem Prärieeulen-Baby, das seine Eltern verloren hat, und finden sein Zuhause.
pr.sub: Dora und Diego retten Baby-Jaguar / Die kleine Eule Cutie

pr.d: Paper pretends to be an expert on cavemen athletics because no one could've possibly studied it before - only to meet an expert. Lou's cat, Meatball, is very sick, and he asks the trio to save him, so they help turn Lou's cat into a vampire.
Tim tut alles, um das neue DinoStar-Spielzeug zu bekommen. Er und Dad müssen einen Maulwurf fangen.
This Old Coffee Pot: After Cecil's moustache springs a leak, he needs Patrick to do his chores around the house. Squidina uses this as an opportunity to produce a home renovation show.
SpongeBob represents Patrick in Kid Court.

1. Geschichte: Damit Mama eine Kolumne über Kindererziehung schreiben darf, muss sie den Redakteur der Zeitung von ihren perfekten Kindern überzeugen. 2. Geschichte: Luna soll für ein paar Tage auf die Katze der McBrides aufpassen. Der Job stellt sich jedoch als anspruchsvoller heraus als von ihr erwartet.

SpongeBob wants to catch an ultra-rare jellyfish and enlists the help of former jellyfishing champion, Kevin; on a trip to the museum, SpongeBob and Patrick teach Sandy all about Bikini Bottom's fascinating, yet questionable, history.

1. Geschichte: Um endlich nicht mehr alleine zu sein, beschließt Lynn sich einen Freund zu suchen. 2. Geschichte: Lincoln und die anderen sollen herausfinden, ob Clydes Schwarm dasselbe für ihn empfindet. Das führt zu einigen Verwicklungen.

Alvin sneaks into Simon's new virtual reality game and is transported to a world in need of a hero; the chipmunks discover Officer Dangus has a twin brother that's a bully and encourage Dangus to stand up to him.
GrandPat sorgt dafür, dass seine wertvollen Erinnerungen nicht auf einem Flohmarkt verkauft werden.
Mysterious lights are messing up the dancing at the firefly prom; the duo follows the jungle sounds to locate a baby monkey.
pr.sub: The Unidentified Shiny Object; The Case of the Crying Monkey

pr.d: Squidina Star stellt einen Assistenten ein, der jedoch etwas zu gut in seinem Job ist.
pr.sub: Squidinas Helferlein; Dem Gestank auf der Spur

pr.d: Hope's in a runaway bouncy ball. A statue is broken, but by whom?
pr.sub: Runaway Hope / Bring me the head of Professor Lopez

pr.d: Schere weigert sich, den Müll hinauszubringen. Papier versucht, ihn zur Erfüllung der Aufgabe zu bringen, bis ein historisches Königreich aus lebenden Abfällen die Wohnung übernimmt, dessen Prinzessin Stein nach der perfekten Romanze sucht.
Stein macht sich auf die Suche nach einem Artefakt. Papier und Schere unterstützen Stein.
pr.sub: Franz Roll und die verschwundenen Regenbogen-Hotpants von Atraxes mit dem Apfelhintern

pr.d: Carlita has transformed into an ice cream truck; before she can deliver sweet treats to all the Gabby Cats, she'll need ice cream, a menu and a song.

Plankton reist zweitausend Jahre in die Zukunft und trifft auf ein paar unbekannte Gesichter. SpongeBob, Patrick und Sandy finden sich mitten in einer langjährigen Fehde zwischen den Narwalen und dem Plankton wieder.

In keeping with one of the Smurfs' traditions, Chef Smurf and Blossom need to find a thirteenth dessert for Christmas dinner. Bubble and Jokey are the worst babysitters. They have turned Baby Smurf into a snail.

SpongeBob will eine seltene Qualle fangen und holt sich Hilfe vom Ex-Quallenfischer-Meister Kevin. Bei einem Museumsausflug bringen SpongeBob und Patrick Sandy alles über die faszinierende und fragwürdige Geschichte von Bikini Bottom bei.
pr.sub: Die Mondqualle / Ein Ausflug ins Museum

pr.d: When Eleanor discovers there are no female knights, she hides in a suit of armour and enters a knight competition; Alvin is having the best dreams of his life, until Theodore subconsciously invades them.
SpongeBob entwickelt eine Allergie gegen sein Zuhause und sucht nach einer neuen Unterkunft. Thaddäus lässt sich die Nase operieren und braucht SpongeBob zur Unterstützung an seiner Seite.

When Alvin makes fun of Simon's magic act, Simon challenges him to a magic duel. Alvin reluctantly signs up to teach the after school music class, but finds his classmates treat him differently as a teacher.

SpongeBob und Patrick verstecken sich in einem Spielzeuggeschäft, das in Bikini Bottom neu eröffnet wurde. Es gefällt ihnen super gut, bis plötzlich das Licht ausgeht und der Horror beginnt. Sie beginnen, zu fantasieren und haben Angst.

Die Kinder versuchen, den örtlichen Rekord im Übernachten auf dem Friedhof zu brechen und ein verfluchtes Huhn belästigt die Casagrandes. Es stellt sich heraus, dass das Huhn eine unerledigte Angelegenheit mit Sergio hat.
pr.sub: Eine Nacht auf dem Friedhof; Der Hühner-Geist

pr.d: Rock is bad at keeping secrets, so when he learns one that will devastate Paper, he goes to great lengths to keep it from him. Sandpaper is disappointed the trio is playing video games all day, so she signs them up for her personal workout program.

Sergio bittet Adelaide um Hilfe, um ein echter Gentleman zu werden und Priscilla zurückzugewinnen. Außerdem hört Rosa, wie Ernesto Estrella vorhersagt, dass Maria und Arturo wieder zusammenkommen könnten. Daraufhin geht sie der Sache nach.
pr.sub: Der Dating-Coach / Ein Leben voller Glückseligkeit

pr.d: Paper pretends to be an expert on cavemen athletics because no one could've possibly studied it before - only to meet an expert. Lou's cat, Meatball, is very sick, and he asks the trio to save him, so they help turn Lou's cat into a vampire.
Als Royal Woods Gefahr droht, beweist die Stadt, dass sie es wert ist, gerettet zu werden.

Ellie and the kids investigate cryptic Mrs. Withers, but when Jack goes missing in her creepy home, Ellie and Lil must save him; eager to become master criminals, Lil and Jack help Chuck with his dirty laundry, but are they ready for a life of crime?
pr.sub: The Three Ravens; Left Holding the Bag

pr.d: Lori und Bobby wollen ihre verrückten Familien an Thanksgiving zum ersten Mal zusammenführen.
With the Paradox Prism in his hands, Nine begins building the Grim into his own personal paradise, unless Sonic and Shadow can convince him otherwise.

Lincoln und seine Schwestern schmieden einen Plan, um etwas Abwechslung in ihr Essen zu bringen. Lincoln muss gemeinsam mit der ruppigen Ronnie Anne an einem Schulprojekt arbeiten. Die beiden passen auf ein "Ei-Baby" auf.
1. Geschichte: Patrick lädt SpongeBob, Sandy und Thaddäus zu einem selbsterfundenen Brettspiel ein. 2. Geschichte: SpongeBob und Thaddäus spülen versehentlich Mr. Krabs' Safe in die Kanalisation.
pr.sub: Patrick! Das Spiel; Durchs Klo gespült

pr.d: While cleaning out their treehouse, the girls reminisce about how they saved the tree from being cut down; Alvin and Theodore think that Simon is going away to boarding school.
SpongeBob bekommt ein neues Paar Hosen - mit langem Bein. Larry eröffnet ein neues Fitness-Studio.

Alvin thinks he's losing his mind when Simon goes missing and no one else even remembers who Simon is. When the girls at school cast votes for the cutest chipmunk on the bathroom wall, Alvin worries about the results.
pr.sub: Oh Brother Where Art Thou; The Wall

pr.d: Sandy unternimmt ein wissenschaftliches Experiment, um das Verhalten von SpongeBob und Patrick zu studieren. Die Situation entgleist jedoch, als das Experiment nicht wie geplant verläuft und unvorhergesehene Konsequenzen nach sich zieht, was zu chaotischen und möglicherweise humorvollen Szenen führt.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: Baby love has never been higher, but a crash is coming, and the Boss Baby and his crew are determined to bring Bubbeezee down for good.

Stein ist krank und kann das Autowasch-Team beim nationalen Autowasch-Tanzwettbewerb nicht anführen, also übernehmen seine Freunde. Schere glaubt, endlich seine Leidenschaft gefunden zu haben, als er sich mit dem Bösewicht Dreamscape zusammentut.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: As the newly named CEO, the Boss Baby sets a goal for baby love to hit 100%, and everyone works overtime to please him.

Die Star-Familie muss einen Weg finden, genug Geld zu verdienen, um in die zweite Staffel der Serie zu kommen. Patrick wird Moderator einer Spielshow und lässt den Rest der Familie an seltsamen Spielen teilnehmen.
pr.sub: Kein Budget für Staffel 2; Die Star Gameshow

pr.d: Pinky, Babs und JJ haben einen 100-Dollar-Schein gefunden und wollen möglichst viel aus ihm herausholen. Als Bob an seinem Geburtstag als Sicherheitsmann im Kaufhaus arbeiten muss, bringt Pinky die Party einfach zu ihm.

Rock is bad at keeping secrets, so when he learns one that will devastate Paper, he goes to great lengths to keep it from him. Sandpaper is disappointed the trio is playing video games all day, so she signs them up for her personal workout program.

Grouse versucht alles, um Lance und seine Familie wieder aus Royal Woods zu vertreiben, nachdem sie nebenan eingezogen sind. // Nachdem Lynn eine Online-Sportshow veröffentlicht hat, lernt sie schnell, wie sich mehr Klicks und Fans generieren lassen.
pr.sub: Nachbarn zum Gruseln / Zur Schnecke gemacht

pr.d: This Old Coffee Pot: After Cecil's moustache springs a leak, he needs Patrick to do his chores around the house. Squidina uses this as an opportunity to produce a home renovation show.
SpongeBob represents Patrick in Kid Court.

Um ihr nächstes goldenes Abzeichen zu erhalten, muss Lola Zeit mit einem Rentner aus dem Sunset Canyon verbringen. Lynn will derweil beweisen, dass sie die beste Loud aller Zeiten ist, als sie die sportlichen Fähigkeiten ihrer Cousine Shilo bemerkt.
pr.sub: Alltags-Engel Lola / Mit Ehrgeiz ins Aus

pr.d: Mrs. Puff's new substitute teacher gives SpongeBob a crash course in driving; Mr. Krabs and Plankton must work together after discovering a well of miracle-grease under their restaurants.
pr.sub: Potato Puff; There Will Be Grease!

pr.d: Das Kängurumaskottchen Crikey hat anscheinend in der Schule randaliert. Das Action News Team versucht, seine Unschuld zu beweisen. Lincoln findet einen Weg, eine Familienregel zu brechen, damit er Loris alte Matratze bekommen kann.
pr.sub: Der Clou mit dem Känguru / Immer der Reihe nach

pr.d: Jack has a farewell party; the family rushes to take Jack to the airport.
SpongeBob arbeitet im härtesten Lokal der Stadt, Karen kümmert sich um Fleckchen.
Captain Perfect's younger sister, Penny, is veering towards a life of supervillain. Keen to impress Captain Perfect, Max takes it upon himself to guide her onto a better path.

Sandy schenkt ihren Freunden spezielle Salzwasserbäume, die mehr Aufmerksamkeit brauchen. SpongeBob und Patrick treffen auf einen Räuber und sind komplett von der Meinung überzeugt, dass es in Wirklichkeit die Zahnfee ist.
pr.sub: Tag des Baumes / Die falsche Zahnfee

pr.d: When Kid Danger and Captain Man battle the Time Bandit, Kid Danger accidentally falls into the Time Bandit's time machine and relives the same day over again.
Die Eltern von SpongeBob kommen zu Besuch und sind auf der Suche nach Abenteuer.
pr.sub: Das Avocado-Dilemma / Augen auf im Straßenverkehr

pr.d: Patricks Limonadenstand ist erfolglos, bis er eine geheime Zutat von Thaddäus bekommt.
Henry receives an invitation to Swellview's most exclusive restaurant and decides to bring his boss, Ray.
Sam and Cat have tickets to go to the Mystic Mountain theme park, but their plans are disrupted when Cat gets trapped inside one of Dice's magic tricks, and the gang must get her out.
As class president, Sadie gets to host the announcements, and Lay Lay comes on the show as the advice expert.
When Chloe announces that Max is her favourite sibling, Phoebe tries to show her the real Max by telling a Robin Hood-style bedtime story about the great Phoebe Hood and the evil Maxingham.
Max and Phoebe surprise their mother by tracking down her long-lost sister, only to find the sisters have been feuding for years.
When Kid Danger is almost badly injured on a mission, Henry decides to go through the Desensitizer to become indestructible like Captain Man.
When Henry gets an unexpected side effect from going through the Desensitizer, he must hide it from his family while the gang works to help him return to normal.

pr.d: SpongeBob's friends tease him after Grandma gives him a kiss. Sick and tired of living between SpongeBob and Patrick, Squidward decides to move out of Bikini Bottom.
Sandy is homesick and plans to return home. The evil Plankton is up to no good once again when he tries to manipulate SpongeBob.
After watching a movie where robots take over the world, SpongeBob thinks Mr. Krabs is a robot. SpongeBob and Patrick find a baby clam and decide to raise it as their own.
Plankton and Mr Krabs have been enemies for a long time. However, Mr Krabs reveals that they were not always this way and that they used to be friends.

Pearl's getting ready for her slumber party, but Mr Krabs' meddling in the party preparations is getting out of control. SpongeBob decides to enter Gary in a pet show and gives him a makeover after seeing the competition.
When the key to the vault holding the Krabby Patty recipe is lost, SpongeBob must locate it before the recipe is lost forever.
After SpongeBob and Patrick eat an experiment, Plankton must counteract the monstrous side effects. Elsewhere, Mr Crab must find a babysitter for Pearl, but she proves to be demanding to care for.
Krabs puts Squidward in charge of all camp complaints. Patrick received a star on his birthday.
Plankton recruits Sandy to help in his lab. SpongeBob's new friend proves unpopular at camp.

When SpongeBob hides the secret formula in his home, it's up to Gary to protect it from Plankton. When a freak accident causes everyone in town to become as stupid as Patrick, Sandy must save the day.

Patrick and Octo must survive together in the forest after Octo twists all of his ankles. The adults sneak off to play a board game, but one of the campers is not easily shaken off.

Sandy creates the latest acorn-based food sensation, but her tree pays the price for her greed. SpongeBob erects a community bulletin board in the Krusty Krab, but anonymous reviews posted on it lead to trouble.
Craig Mammalton learns what it's like to not be the best at something; Patrick and a cake hide out in the wilderness.

Poirot wird von Lady Chatterton gebeten, ein Auge auf ihre Freundin Marguerite Clayton zu haben, die sich von ihrem Mann bedroht fühlt. Kurz darauf wird dessen Leiche in einer spanischen Truhe in der Wohnung von Major Rich entdeckt.

Poirot wird vom Wirt eines Landgasthofs per Brief gebeten, einen dreifachen Giftmord aufzuklären. Bei seiner Ankunft muss er jedoch erfahren, dass das Verbrechen nur auf dem Papier existiert: im selbstverfassten Kriminalroman des Wirts.
Während einer Hamlet-Probe wird ein Theaterregisseur tot aufgefunden, auch Drama hinter der Bühne.

Die Entdeckung der Leiche eines jungen Mädchens, sowie einiger grotesker Zeichnungen, führt Murdoch zu dem Verdacht, dass eine Gruppe von Jugendlichen, die vom Tod besessen sind, dahintersteckt. Unter ihnen ist auch ein gewisser H. P. Lovecraft.

Im Auftrag von Sir Henry Coverly beschattet Mr. Whicher dessen Frau wegen des Verdachts der ehelichen Untreue. Er findet heraus, dass Lady Jane Coverly ein Verhältnis mit Matthew Thorogood hat. Nachdem er Sir Henry Bericht erstattet hat und es zu einem Scheidungstermin vor Gericht kommt, erscheint Matthew Thorogood trotz Vorladung nicht. Als Mr. Whicher der Sache nachgeht, findet er Matthew kurz darauf ermordet im Wald.

In Bad Dürkheim treten der "Marokkaner Deines Vertrauens" Abdelkarim, die jungen Comedians Ivan Thieme und Sara Karas sowie der Meister deutsch-russischer Comedy Nikita Miller zu einem unterhaltsamen Comedy-Festival auf.

Charlotte bemüht sich Friedrich gegenüber um Normalität, auch wenn ihr das nur schwer gelingt: Barbaras Behauptung hat sie sehr verunsichert. Als Charlotte einen schlimmen Albtraum hat, in dem Friedrich sie umbringt, begreift sie, dass sie ihn endlich mit Barbaras Verdacht konfrontieren muss. Charlotte stellt Friedrich schließlich erneut die Frage, ob er Patrizia wirklich nicht die Treppe heruntergestoßen habe. Friedrich leugnet zunächst, doch Charlotte setzt ihn weiter unter Druck.

Leonard sucht Paulines Nähe und bietet ihr an, ein Praktikum bei ihm in der Geschäftsführung zu machen, um sich in die Hotelleitung einzuarbeiten. Pauline zögert, doch sie sehnt sich nach Leonards Nähe. Leonard gesteht derweil Martin, dass auch er auf eine Versöhnung hofft. Als Friedrich Pauline in Anwesenheit eines Notars schließlich die 20 Prozent seiner Anteile überschreibt, erleidet er einen Schwächeanfall. Charlotte erwartet von Friedrich, dass er sich selbst anzeigt.

Barbara missfällt die neuerliche Annäherung zwischen Pauline und Leonard. Sie erinnert Leonard an seine Pflicht als werdender Vater, doch Leonard weist die Verantwortung für die Zwillinge zunächst harsch zurück - bis in ihm ungeahnte Vatergefühle erwachen, als er den Herzschlag seiner vermeintlichen Kinder hört. Pauline indes hadert mit sich, ob der Preis für ihr Glück mit Leonard nicht zu hoch ist, und trifft eine folgenschwere Entscheidung.

Leonard beteuert zwar, dass sich seine Gefühle geändert haben, als er im Krankenhaus die Herztöne seiner vermeintlichen Kinder gehört hat, doch Pauline glaubt ihm nicht. Auch behagt es ihr nicht, dass sie nun als Anteilseignerin noch viel mehr an den "Fürstenhof" und damit auch an Leonard gebunden ist. Als Charlotte Leonard erklärt, dass die Liebe allein manchmal nicht reicht, wenn die Basis einer Beziehung zerstört ist, schreibt er Pauline einen Brief, deren Zeilen sie mitten ins Herz treffen.

Ein Schuppen in der Schrebergartenkolonie ist Brandstiftern zum Opfer gefallen. Die Laubenpieper werden seit Monaten regelrecht terrorisiert. Einige Schrebergärtner, angeführt von dem streitbaren Werner Bauer, behaupten zu wissen, wer hinter den Anschlägen steckt: die neue Wirtin des Vereinsheimes, Dorothea Winninger. Seit sie hier lebt und arbeitet, ist es mit dem Frieden in der Kolonie dahin. Entsprechend aufgeheizt ist die Stimmung.

Die Wahrsagerin Madame Rubina prophezeit Julia, dass sie ihren Ex Sergej Raihmann schon bald wiedersehen werde - den Mann, der sie um 250.000 Euro betrogen hatte und mit Schulden und Baby Ellie vor einem Jahr hat sitzen lassen. Julia befragt die Wahrsagerin, weil sich der Unternehmer Gerhard Schaller von ihr betrogen sieht. Johannes wollte den lästigen Fall loswerden und auch Julia ist nicht begeistert von dieser Ermittlung.

Ben gibt Thomas bei dessen Auseinandersetzung mit Simone zwar recht, aber privat steht er zu Simone. Doch auch Ben hat mitbekommen, dass zwischen Simone und Eliane Spannungen herrschen. Simone leugnet das jedoch. Als aber Eliane eine Bluse nicht rechtzeitig für ihre Talkshow fertig hat, verliert Simone die Contenance und wird Eliane gegenüber rassistisch ausfällig. Ben ist schockiert. Lasse gibt keine Erklärung zu seiner Reaktion auf den Streit des Schlagerpaares.

Durch den Streit im Drei Könige wird Lasse an seine Vergangenheit erinnert. Er will sich ein paar Tage zurückziehen, um seine Gedanken zu ordnen. Nora ahnt, dass es in seinem Leben ein traumatisches Ereignis gegeben hat. Aber Lasse wurmt auch, dass Volker ständig um Nora herumscharwenzelt. Diesem Schnösel wird er Nora nicht überlassen! Ben ist geschockt von Simones rassistischer Äußerung über Eliane. Er stellt sich natürlich auf Elianes Seite und verlangt, dass Simone sich entschuldigt.

Schwester Arzu und Dr. David Engel haben eine schöne Zeit miteinander. Doch Arzu weiß nicht, wohin diese Liaison führen soll. Während David jeden Augenblick mit ihr genießt, ist sie vorsichtiger. Werden sie vielleicht ein Paar? Philipp Brentano lernt Tilmann Sachs und seine Freundin Judith Jansen kennen.

Hans-Peter Brenner arbeitet ehrenamtlich in einer Einrichtung für Obdachlose, im "Haus Lichtblick". Er ist fasziniert von der charismatischen Leiterin Gaby Ludwig, die die Einrichtung aufgebaut hat. Dort lernt Brenner den obdachlosen Herbert Stremann, genannt Gurke, kennen. Gurke wird nach einem Unfall, bei dem er sich am Kopf verletzt, in die Sachsenklinik eingeliefert. Nach der Wundversorgung will er die Klinik schon wieder verlassen, erleidet aber einen Zusammenbruch.
No description available · EPGTalk.com
Zu ihrer eigenen Überraschung wird Julia Klug zur Hauptkommissarin befördert und teilt ab sofort das Büro mit ihrem Ex-Chef Johannes Sonntag. Der ist darüber alles andere als begeistert.

Horst Kopke, der Besitzer des bekannten Oldtimer-Autohauses Kopke Original, wird bei dem Einwurf der Tageseinnahmen tödlich von einem fahrenden Auto erfasst. Wurde er Opfer eines Unfalls mit Fahrerflucht oder eines geplanten Mordes?

Lasse begreift, dass er sich in Sachen Nora mehr ins Zeug legen muss. Durch einen Hinweis von Thomas sieht er einen Weg, Nora seine Zuneigung zu zeigen. Nora gibt gegenüber Carla zu, dass Lasse zwar ihr Typ ist, sie aber keine Lust auf komplizierte Männer hat. Umso berührter ist sie, als Lasse eine Überraschung für sie hat. Eliane konzentriert sich nach ihrem Zerwürfnis mit Ben ganz auf ihre Arbeit, lehnt die Einladung zum Konzert von Betty Kayser ab.

Nora und Lasse stehen im Wechselbad ihrer Gefühle. Sie ist irritiert über seine unvermittelte Annäherung, er ist enttäuscht über ihre distanzierte Haltung zu seiner Idee mit der Büchertauschbörse. Aber Lasse gibt nicht auf und will Nora mit einer Vorabausgabe ihres Lieblingsautors überraschen. Die Gefühle brechen sich nun endlich Bahn. Henri hat gerade Edda kennengelernt und ist sofort verzaubert.

Emma kann nicht fassen, dass Rosalie Tilkowskis unmoralisches Angebot angenommen hat. Sie erzählt den Sonnbichlern von der Geldnot ihrer Schwester. Alfons bietet Rosalie daraufhin Geld an - unter der Voraussetzung, dass sie sich einen Job besorgt.

Rosalie befürchtet, André könne sie vor Felix verpfeifen und überlegt, wie sie ihn ruhigstellen kann. Sie bietet ihm Geld, doch André fordert stattdessen ein Treffen, bei dem er sie über die Geschichte mit Tilkowski ausfragt und ihr Ratschläge gibt.

Bei einem Anwaltsbesuch wegen eines Hauskaufs leitet Franziska versehentlich die Scheidung von Will ein, einem viel beschäftigten Regisseur, der sie mit den gemeinsamen Kindern ohnehin meist alleine lässt und sie mit den Hauptdarstellerinnen betrügt. Unter einem Pseudonym schreibt sie ein Buch, in dem sie ihre Beziehung verarbeitet. Nachdem dieses sich als Bestseller entpuppt, wird es ausgerechnet von ihrem zukünftigen Ex-Mann verfilmt.

Die Moderatorin lädt die Frauen zu einem Kinoabend ein. In gemeinsamer Runde blicken die Frauen auf ihre Reise zurück und öffnen sich ehrlich, ungefiltert und mit offenem Herzen ihrem neuen Ich. Der nächste Tag widmet sich ganz der Sinnlichkeit.

Die sexologische Körperarbeiterin nimmt die Frauen mit auf eine Entdeckungsreise durch die weibliche Anatomie. Saras bewegende Vergangenheit und Vivis tiefe Einsamkeit hinterlassen Spuren in der Gruppe. Am Abend findet die Pride-Party statt.

Nach der Pride-Party ist Vivi während eines Gesprächs mit Sara wütend. Hedda will, dass beide einen guten Umgang mit Konflikten lernen. Marys und Rüki klären ein Thema, das Marys schon eine Weile mit Rüki besprechen wollte.

Zum Schluss folgt eine emotionale Achterbahnfahrt. Franzi kommt gestärkt und sichtbar befreit aus ihrer Einzelsession zurück. Am Abend gibt es Post von zu Hause. Dann ist es so weit: Die Moderatorin läutet das große Finale ein.

Im Jahr 1979 soll Michael Levine, ein Undercover-Agent der US-Drogenbehörde, die Verbreitung der neuen Droge Kokain stoppen. Währenddessen plant der Drogenboss Roberto Suárez mit dem NS-Kriegsverbrecher Klaus Barbie einen Putsch in Bolivien.

Michael Levine und seinen Undercover-Agenten gelingt es, im bolivischen Dschungel eine Tonne Kokain zu beschlagnahmen und einige von Roberto Suárez' Komplizen festzunehmen. Diese sind jedoch schon kurz nach ihrer Verhaftung wieder auf freiem Fuß.

Zur Feier der Machtübernahme über Bolivien schmeißen Roberto Suárez und Klaus Altmann ein großes Fest. Mit der neuen Regierung verdienen sie Milliarden durch den Handel von Drogen. Gegen ihre Gegner gehen sie auf brutale Weise vor.

Gladys Godfrey/Ian McNicholl. How did forensic technology help track down the killer of Gladys Godfrey? Plus, Ian McNicholl tells the horrific story of his abusive ex-girlfriend. S5, Ep2
Phillip Fraser. In 1997, Phillip Fraser murdered his ex-partner. His daughter recalls the events and reveals how witnessing the aftermath of the crime has affected her. S1, Ep6

pr.t: On the Case with Paula Zahn
pr.d: A Call For Answers. After police find a young mother bound and murdered in her bedroom, her family challenges police to bring a heartless killer to justice. S12, Ep26
Seeking Out Maple. Maple Batalia is found dead in the parking lot of Simon Fraser University. With over a hundred cameras at their disposal, can detectives figure out who killed her? S4, Ep16
Paul Hutchinson. In Nottinghamshire, 1983, a 16-year-old girl is found raped and murdered. Decades later, advances in forensic technology enable police to find a DNA match. S1, Ep2
Stage Fright. Stephanie is a gifted stage performer and much-loved teacher. But behind closed doors, resentment and envy fester in her marriage, leading to a shocking 911 call. S7, Ep7
Dance With Me. Ramon Sosa is a father of three who runs a successful boxing gym in Texas. He feels like the luckiest man alive until someone marks him for murder. S7, Ep13
The Girl In The Park. A group of men discover a woman's body in a park in Red Valley, Arizona. Investigators have leads, but can they gather enough concrete evidence? S4, Ep2
Rachel Williams/Thomas Edwards. A woman's life hangs in the balance after she escapes a controlling relationship. Plus, a family are left devastated as a result of dangerous driving. S5, Ep4
Body Heat. In 2018, Kathy Blair was found murdered at home. Detectives find camera footage containing a shadowy figure that might just be their killer. S9, Ep18
All Eyes On Megan. When a teenager goes missing, detectives struggle for leads. But when surveillance cameras reveal her kidnapping, the case becomes a race to bring her home alive. S3, Ep3
...Killer: People Magazine Investigates. In 1980, a couple disappears and is later discovered in a field. It will take 40 years before a woman claims to hold the key to unlocking the case.
It's Your Funeral. The Cape Cod coastline is bathed in blood after one family's fight for fortune turns deadly. The investigation uncovers liars on the path toward finding a killer. S4, Ep9
